simp_chinese: 迈诺阿属于加勒比海中的古巴。西班牙殖民开始时，广义古巴岛屿世界已有瓜纳哈塔贝人与泰诺人等族群，主岛周围还分布着数千座小岛与沙洲。

english: The country around Mayo forms part of the traditional territory of the Na-Cho Nyäk Dun, the 'Big River People' of the northeastern Yukon. They are the northernmost representatives of Northern Tutchone language and culture, with family connections also reaching toward Gwich'in communities to the north and Dene peoples to the east. Their historical territory encompasses rivers, lakes and mountain ranges, and living from the land remains an important part of their culture. The town of Mayo itself arose only in 1903, after gold had been discovered on the Stewart River in 1883. These later settlements occupy a landscape with a much older Indigenous history.
simp_chinese: 梅奥一带属于育空东北部纳乔尼亚克敦人的传统领地，他们的名称意为“大河之民”。他们是北图乔内语言与文化分布最北的一支，家族渊源也延伸至北方的圭琴社群和东方的德内诸族。其历史领地包括众多河流、湖泊与山脉，依靠土地生活至今仍是其文化的重要部分。梅奥镇本身直到1903年才建立，此前1883年斯图尔特河发现了黄金。这些较晚出现的聚落，坐落在拥有更古老原住民历史的土地之上。

sources.title: First Nation of Na-Cho Nyak Dun

english: Mayo Bay faces the eastern Mindanao coastal region of Davao Oriental. This is a traditional homeland of Mandaya and Kalagan communities, with the Philippine Sea opening to the east.
simp_chinese: 梅奥湾面向棉兰老岛东部的东达沃沿海地区。这里是曼达亚人与卡拉甘社群的传统家园，东方通向菲律宾海。

english: Mayrinax belongs to Taiwan, an island between the East China Sea and the South China Sea. Across the wider island, mountain ranges dominate the eastern two-thirds while broader plains occupy the west.
simp_chinese: 汶水泰雅位于东海与南海之间的台湾岛上。在整座岛屿的地理格局中，东部约三分之二以山地为主，较为宽阔的平原则分布在西部。

english: The Mayu River Estuary opens into the Bay of Bengal near Sittwe. The river links the coast with Rathedaung and Buthidaung, and small boats can travel a considerable distance upstream.
simp_chinese: 马尤河口在实兑附近通入孟加拉湾。河流连接海岸与拉代当、布迪当，小船可向上游航行相当远的距离。

english: Mayumba is a coastal town in southwestern Gabon, facing the Atlantic Ocean in Nyanga country. Its sandy beaches are nesting grounds for leatherback turtles, while the surrounding coast extends south toward the area now protected as Mayumba National Park.
simp_chinese: 马永巴是加蓬西南部尼扬加地区面向大西洋的沿海城镇。镇边沙滩是棱皮龟产卵地，周围海岸向南延伸至今日受马永巴国家公园保护的地区。

english: The Mayumba Coast fronts a peninsula between the Atlantic and Banio Lagoon in Gabon. Sandy beaches provide nesting grounds for leatherback turtles. Around the wider coastal settlement, Vili, Lumbu and Punu communities harvest lagoon oysters seasonally, amid savanna and coastal wetlands.
simp_chinese: 马永巴海岸面向加蓬大西洋与巴尼奥潟湖之间的半岛。沙滩为棱皮龟提供筑巢地。在更广阔的沿海聚落周围，维利、伦布与普努社群季节性采收潟湖牡蛎，周边交织着稀树草原与海岸湿地。

english: Mayuragiri belongs to the Baglana country of the northern Deccan. The wider medieval principality stood on the main trade route linking Surat with Daulatabad and Golconda, and its rulers bore the title Baharji.
simp_chinese: 马由拉盖里属于德干北部的巴格拉纳地区。更广阔的中世纪公国位于连接苏拉特、道拉塔巴德与戈尔康达的主要商路上，统治者使用巴哈尔吉的称号。

english: Maya belongs to Yakutia within the broad Eastern Siberian region. This immense part of northern Asia extends east of the Yenisei toward the Pacific drainage divides. Plateaus dominate much of its area, with tundra to the north and mountain belts farther south.
simp_chinese: 马亚属于广义东西伯利亚地区中的雅库特。这片辽阔北亚地域由叶尼塞河以东延伸向太平洋分水岭。高原占据大片土地，北有苔原，南有山地。

english: Mayyafariqin, later known as Silvan, stood among the cities linking Upper Mesopotamia with the Armenian uplands. In late antiquity it bore the name Martyropolis, the 'City of Martyrs', after Bishop Maruthas brought Christian relics from the Sasanian Empire. Under Muslim rule it became the capital of the Kurdish Marwanid dynasty before the Seljuks took the region in 1085. Later rulers included the Artuqids, whose patronage produced the great Malabadi Bridge nearby. In 1260, the Ayyubid ruler al-Kamil Muhammad defended the city against the Mongols, but its fall brought a massacre of its population. The succession of churches, dynasties and monumental works reflects both the prosperity and the vulnerability of this contested upland frontier.
simp_chinese: 玛亚法里钦，后称锡尔万，是连接上美索不达米亚与亚美尼亚高地的城市之一。古代晚期，主教马鲁塔斯从萨珊帝国带回基督教殉道者圣髑后，城市获得了“殉道者之城”马尔提罗波利斯之名。穆斯林统治时期，这里成为库尔德马尔万王朝的都城，直到塞尔柱人于1085年夺取整个地区。后来的统治者包括阿尔图格王朝，他们资助在附近建成了宏伟的马拉巴迪桥。1260年，阿尤布统治者卡米勒·穆罕默德抵抗蒙古军队，城破后人口遭到屠杀。先后出现的教会、王朝与大型建筑，既体现了这处争夺不断的高地边疆的繁荣，也揭示了它的脆弱。

english: Mazagão carries an Atlantic migration into the Amazonian country of Amapá. Its name came from the Portuguese stronghold of Mazagão on the Moroccan coast, now El Jadida. When Portugal evacuated that possession in 1769, many inhabitants were transferred to Brazil: 340 families reached Belém in 1770 and went to Nova Mazagão in 1773. That settlement survives as Mazagão Velho, distinct from the later municipal centre. Its Festival of São Tiago reenacts conflict between Moors and Christians, preserving a memory of the community’s North African past. Pottery, ceramics, Brazil nuts and rubber also became associated with the surrounding region.
simp_chinese: 马萨冈的历史将一次大西洋移民带入阿马帕的亚马孙地区。其名称源于葡萄牙在摩洛哥海岸的据点马萨冈，即今日的杰迪代。1769年葡萄牙撤离该地时，许多居民被转迁至巴西：340个家庭于1770年抵达贝伦，1773年前往新马萨冈。这个聚落如今作为旧马萨冈保留下来，与后来的市政中心有所区别。当地圣地亚哥节重演摩尔人与基督徒的冲突，保存着社群北非往事的记忆。陶器、陶瓷、巴西坚果和橡胶也成为周边地区的重要特色。

english: Mazaghan belongs to the Dukkala country of Morocco on the western side of the Maghreb. This broader North African region was shaped by Berber societies and Muslim dynasties including the Almoravids and Almohads, whose influence also reached Iberia.
simp_chinese: 马扎汗属于马格里布西侧摩洛哥的杜卡拉地区。这片更广阔的北非区域由柏柏尔社会及穆拉比特、穆瓦希德等穆斯林王朝塑造，其影响还延伸到伊比利亚。

english: Mazar-i-Sharif grew around a shrine near ancient Balkh, in the northern plains of Afghanistan and the historical country of Khorasan. Its name refers to the sacred tomb traditionally identified with Ali, cousin and son-in-law of Muhammad; that attribution belongs to the shrine's religious tradition. The Seljuk sultan Ahmad Sanjar ordered a shrine and settlement here, later destroyed during the Mongol invasions and subsequently rebuilt. The blue-tiled sanctuary became the city's defining monument. Durrani sovereignty reached the region around 1751, although autonomous Uzbek rulers continued to wield local power. After Qilich Ali Beg's death in 1817, Balkh and Mazar formed an independent city-state before a Bukharan conquest in 1837.
simp_chinese: 马扎里沙里夫围绕古巴尔赫附近的一座陵祠发展起来，位于阿富汗北部平原及历史上的呼罗珊地区。其名指向传统上被认作穆罕默德堂弟兼女婿阿里之墓的圣陵；这一认定属于陵祠的宗教传统。塞尔柱苏丹艾哈迈德·桑贾尔下令在此修建陵祠与聚落，后来它们毁于蒙古入侵，随后又获重建。蓝色瓷砖装饰的圣所成为城市最鲜明的建筑。约1751年，杜兰尼的主权延伸至本区，但自治的乌兹别克统治者仍掌握地方权力。1817年奇利奇·阿里伯克去世后，巴尔赫与马扎里沙里夫组成独立城邦，直到1837年遭布哈拉征服。

english: Mazar Tagh rises in the Taklamakan north of Khotan, carrying the ruins of a fortress from the Tibetan imperial age. Before the garrison arrived, the hill appears to have been a Buddhist pilgrimage site within the kingdom of Khotan. The Tibetan outpost housed soldiers, families, officials and merchants. Its discarded eighth- and ninth-century records, written on wood and paper, preserve unusually detailed traces of their administration. Fragments in Khotanese, Uyghur and Sogdian also emerged from the site. The later Turkic name means Hill of the Sacred Shrine, referring to the Islamic sanctuary maintained on the hill.
simp_chinese: 麻扎塔格矗立于和田以北的塔克拉玛干沙漠中，山上留有吐蕃帝国时期的堡垒遗址。驻军到来以前，这座山似乎是于阗王国内的一处佛教朝圣地。吐蕃前哨中除士兵外，还住着家属、官员和商人。当地遗弃的8至9世纪木牍与纸本文书，保存了异常细致的行政生活痕迹。遗址还出土了于阗文、回鹘文与粟特文残片。后来采用的突厥语名称意为“圣祠之山”，指向山上延续供奉的伊斯兰圣祠。

english: Mazara stands at the mouth of the Mazaro River on the western Sicilian coast, where Phoenician pottery and inscriptions preserve traces of an ancient trading harbour. Arab forces occupied it in 827, and it became an important port and centre of learning in the region that bore its name, the Val di Mazara. Roger I's Normans took the city in 1072; a bishopric followed in 1093. The Norman legacy includes San Nicolò Regale, a church built in 1124, and the surviving arch of a castle raised soon after the conquest. The port's long history of commerce was later joined by a major fishing industry.
simp_chinese: 马扎拉坐落在西西里西岸的马扎罗河口，出土的腓尼基陶器与铭文保留着古代贸易港的痕迹。阿拉伯军队于827年占领此地，城镇随后成为重要的港口与学术中心，所在地区也以它为名，称为马扎拉区。罗杰一世率领的诺曼人于1072年夺取城市，1093年又在此设立主教区。诺曼时代留下了1124年兴建的圣尼科洛王室教堂，以及征服后不久修筑的城堡残存拱门。港口悠久的商业传统，后来又与规模可观的渔业相结合。

english: Mazatepec lies in the broader country associated with the Guachichil of north-central Mexico. Their territories extended across Zacatecas and parts of San Luis Potosí, Guanajuato and Jalisco, and they became prominent in resistance to Spanish settlement.
simp_chinese: 马萨特佩克位于墨西哥中北部与瓜奇奇尔人相关的更广阔地区。他们的领地跨越萨卡特卡斯及圣路易斯波托西、瓜纳华托和哈利斯科部分地区，并在抵抗西班牙殖民中发挥显著作用。

english: Mazatlán faces the Pacific from Sinaloa, opposite the southern tip of Baja California. Spanish colonization began in 1531, and the port later handled machinery for nearby gold and silver mines.
simp_chinese: 马萨特兰从锡那罗亚海岸面向太平洋，与下加利福尼亚半岛南端隔海相望。西班牙殖民活动始于1531年，港口后来还承担了附近金银矿所需设备的输入。

english: Mazatlán Coast lies on Mexico’s Pacific side opposite the southern end of Baja California. The neighbouring port grew through commerce with inland gold and silver mines, while its Nahuatl name means place of deer.
simp_chinese: 马萨特兰海岸位于墨西哥太平洋一侧，面向下加利福尼亚南端。邻近港口因与内陆金银矿的贸易而发展，纳瓦特尔语地名意为鹿之地。

english: Mazatlpilli belongs to the Guachichil country of central Mexico. The wider people occupied an extensive territory across Zacatecas and neighbouring lands, and their position near Spanish mines and roads made their resistance especially effective during the Chichimeca Wars.
simp_chinese: 马萨特尔皮利属于墨西哥中部瓜奇奇尔地区。更广阔的族群占据萨卡特卡斯及邻地的广大土地，靠近西班牙矿区与道路的位置使其在奇奇梅克战争中的抵抗格外有效。

english: Mazdavand stands in the Marzdaran region on the approaches to Sarakhs in northeastern Iran. Its position has strategic importance, and nearby Mazdavand Cave forms a notable feature of the surrounding landscape.
simp_chinese: 马兹达万德位于伊朗东北部通向萨拉赫斯的马尔兹达兰地区。位置具有战略意义，附近马兹达万德洞穴则是周围景观的重要特色。

english: Mažeikiai stands on the Venta River in northwestern Lithuania, within the historical country of Samogitia. A Livonian chronicle records the devastation of Duke Mažeika's land during an expedition in 1335, linking the locality's name with the conflicts along Lithuania's northern frontier. The much larger town familiar today developed later, especially after construction of the Libau-Romny railway in 1869. Its position as a railway junction became important enough to prompt competing Lithuanian and Latvian claims after the First World War. These later developments should not obscure the earlier identity of a Samogitian river landscape behind the modern city.
simp_chinese: 马热伊基艾位于立陶宛西北部文塔河畔，属于历史上的萨莫吉希亚地区。利沃尼亚编年史记载，1335年的一次远征摧毁了马热伊卡公爵的领地，将当地名称与立陶宛北部边疆的冲突联系起来。今天所见规模较大的城镇形成得更晚，尤其受1869年利鲍—罗姆内铁路建设推动。其铁路枢纽地位后来重要到引发第一次世界大战后立陶宛与拉脱维亚的竞争性领土要求。在现代城市背后，当地仍承载着较早的萨莫吉希亚河流地域身份。

english: Mazhan belongs to the Birjand country of southern Khorasan. Birjand appears in a thirteenth-century geographical work by Yaqut, which described it as a notable town of Qohestan.
simp_chinese: 马赞属于南呼罗珊的比尔詹德地区。比尔詹德见于雅古特的十三世纪地理著作，书中将其描述为库希斯坦的一座著名城镇。

english: Mazinaw belongs to eastern Ontario. Indigenous peoples occupied this broader region for thousands of years before European settlement, including Anishinaabe, Algonquin and Haudenosaunee communities.
simp_chinese: 马齐诺属于安大略东部。欧洲移民到来前，原住民已在这一广阔地区居住数千年，包括阿尼希纳贝人、阿尔冈昆人与豪德诺索尼人。

english: Mazongshan belongs to the wider Shazhou-Dunhuang border country. The Dunhuang oasis commanded crossroads leading toward India, Mongolia and the Hexi Corridor, linking the Chinese interior with western routes.
simp_chinese: 马鬃山属于广阔的沙州—敦煌边地。敦煌绿洲控制着通往印度、蒙古与河西走廊的交通交汇点，将中国内陆与西行道路联系起来。

english: Mazouna once served as the capital of the Ottoman western province in Algeria. Its Elzawya mosque also became a respected school for teaching the Quran, joining political importance with religious learning.
simp_chinese: 马祖纳曾是奥斯曼统治下阿尔及利亚西部行省的首府。埃尔扎维亚清真寺也是备受尊重的古兰经学校，使政治地位与宗教学术相结合。

english:
Mazyr stands on the Pripyat, east of Pinsk, and first appears in surviving records in 1155. Within the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth it served as a county seat in the Minsk Voivodeship. Eighteenth-century religious foundations gave the town Baroque churches and monasteries for Cistercian monks and nuns, while a Jesuit school moved here from Jurewicze around 1729. Lithuanian vanguard regiments were also stationed in the town at different times.

The partitions brought Russian rule and eventual suppression of the Cistercian houses. The women's convent became an Orthodox monastery. Plans to demolish the men's monastery were abandoned after it sheltered Jewish residents following a town fire, an episode in which a threatened religious building became a refuge for another community. Later fairs continued to draw commercial life to this old riverside centre.
simp_chinese:
莫济里坐落于平斯克以东的普里皮亚季河畔，现存文献最早于1155年记载此地。在波兰立陶宛联邦时期，它是明斯克省的一处县治。十八世纪的宗教建设为城镇留下了巴洛克式教堂，以及熙笃会男女修道院；约1729年，一所耶稣会学校从尤雷维切迁到这里。立陶宛前卫骑兵团也曾在不同时期驻扎于此。

瓜分波兰后，城镇归俄罗斯统治，熙笃会修道院后来被关闭。女修道院改为东正教修道院，男修道院则一度面临拆毁；但它在一场城镇大火后收容了犹太居民，拆除计划因此放弃。一座自身命运未卜的宗教建筑，就这样成了另一群居民的避难所。此后的定期集市继续为这座古老河畔中心带来商业活动。

english: Mbaba belongs to the wider lower-Congo cultural world of the Kongo people. Kikongo-speaking communities occupied several Atlantic-facing kingdoms, including Kongo, Loango and Kakongo. Portuguese traders reached this regional world in 1483, followed by the spread of Catholicism among some Kongo communities.
simp_chinese: 姆巴巴属于刚果河下游广阔的刚果人文化世界。使用刚果语的社群生活于面向大西洋的多个王国，包括刚果、卢安果和卡孔果。葡萄牙商人于1483年进入这一地区，天主教随后在部分刚果社群中传播。

english: Mbai Yuru belongs to the Piquiri river country of southern Brazil. The Piquiri drains into the Paraná and receives tributaries including the Azul. Historical spellings of its name include Pequirí and Piquiry.
simp_chinese: 姆巴伊尤鲁属于巴西南部皮基里河地域。皮基里河汇入巴拉那河，接纳包括阿祖尔河在内的支流。其名称的历史拼写包括Pequirí与Piquiry。

english: Mbaiki stands in the Lobaye country of southwestern Central Africa, where Lobaye communities live alongside forest peoples. A waterfall lies near the town, while timber and coffee became important to its later economy. The settlement's recorded colonial history belongs to the twentieth century: France ceded it to Germany in the Morocco-Congo agreement of 1911, making it part of Neukamerun. French forces recovered it during the First World War. These later shifts of colonial boundaries overlaid an older regional landscape of local communities.
simp_chinese: 姆拜基地处中非西南部的洛巴耶地区，洛巴耶社群与森林居民共同生活在这一带。城镇附近有瀑布，木材与咖啡则在较晚时期成为当地经济的重要组成部分。聚落有记载的殖民历史属于二十世纪：法国依1911年的摩洛哥—刚果协定将其让予德国，使其成为新喀麦隆的一部分。第一次世界大战期间，法军重新夺取此地。这些较晚的殖民边界变动，叠加在当地社群生活已久的地域之上。

english: The Mbaka homeland extends across parts of the Central African Republic and northwestern Congo. Their language belongs to the Ubangian group, within the varied linguistic landscape of central Africa.
simp_chinese: 姆巴卡人的故土分布于中非共和国及刚果西北部部分地区。他们的语言属于乌班吉语言群，是中非多样语言地域的一部分。

english: Mbakaou lies in Cameroon's Adamawa region within the Tibati community. Fishing forms the main basis of local livelihoods, while later dam construction has added a large artificial lake to the landscape.
simp_chinese: 姆巴考位于喀麦隆阿达马瓦地区的蒂巴提辖区。捕鱼是当地生计的主要基础，后来的筑坝工程又为地貌增添了大型人工湖。

english: Mbam belongs to the Cameroon highland world. The Western High Plateau is a region of cool, rainy uplands and savanna, built around mountains and volcanoes along the Cameroon line.
simp_chinese: 姆巴姆属于喀麦隆高地地区。西部高原气候凉爽多雨，兼有高地与稀树草原，围绕喀麦隆火山线上的山岭和火山展开。

english: The Imbangala emerged in seventeenth-century Angola as mobile warrior groups. They served both Portuguese forces and their regional opponents, participating in warfare and the slave trade. Some later founded the Kasanje kingdom, turning military organisation into a more enduring political authority.
simp_chinese: 因班加拉人于十七世纪在安哥拉以流动武装群体的形态出现。他们既为葡萄牙军队效力，也服务于其地区对手，参与战争与奴隶贸易。其中一部分后来建立卡桑杰王国，将军事组织转化为更持久的政治权力。

english: Mbanza Kongo crowns a flat-topped mountain above the Luezi valley, at a junction of the routes that sustained the Kingdom of Kongo. Associated with its first king, Lukeni lua Nimi, the city was already a great capital when Portuguese visitors reached it in 1491. One ambassador compared its enclosed centre with Évora. Christian churches and the royal palace later reshaped the hilltop, and the name São Salvador appeared in royal correspondence during Álvaro I's reign. Civil war after the battle of Mbwila brought repeated sacks and abandonment in 1678. Dona Beatriz Kimpa Vita's followers reoccupied the city in 1705, and Pedro IV restored it as the capital in 1709. The royal judgement tree and the surviving sacred sites preserve memories of authority that joined African kingship and Christianity.
simp_chinese: 姆班扎刚果雄踞卢埃济河谷上方的一座平顶山，位于支撑刚果王国的交通路线交汇处。城市的起源与首位国王卢凯尼·卢阿·尼米相连；1491年葡萄牙来访者抵达时，它已是一座规模宏大的都城。一位使节曾将其有围墙的中心与埃武拉相比。此后，基督教堂与王宫重塑了山顶景观，阿尔瓦罗一世在位时的王室书信开始使用圣萨尔瓦多之名。姆布维拉战役后的内战使城市屡遭洗劫，并于1678年被放弃。多娜·贝阿特丽丝·金帕·维塔的追随者于1705年重返城中，佩德罗四世又在1709年恢复其首都地位。王室裁决树与留存的神圣场所，延续着将非洲王权和基督教结合在一起的权威记忆。

english: Mbanza Mbata belongs to the historical Kongo kingdom. Its wider political world consisted of core provinces under the Mwene Kongo and extended influence toward neighboring kingdoms along the Atlantic and Congo interior.
simp_chinese: 姆班扎姆巴塔属于历史上的刚果王国。广大政治世界由姆韦内刚果统治下的核心省份组成，并向大西洋沿岸和刚果内陆的邻近王国施加影响。

english: Mbanza Mpangu lies in the wider Kinshasa region beside the lower Congo’s great transport corridor. On this regional scale, navigation above the Livingstone Falls and the interruption of river traffic by the falls explain the importance of the river ports; the later railway to Matadi connected the two stretches.
simp_chinese: 姆班扎姆潘古位于广义的金沙萨地区，靠近刚果河下游的重要交通走廊。在地区尺度上，利文斯通瀑布上游可航行的河段，以及瀑布对直通水运的阻隔，解释了河港的重要性；后来通往马塔迪的铁路连接了两段运输线路。

english: Mbanza Mpemba belongs to the historical kingdom of Kongo. The wider kingdom comprised several core provinces under the Mwene Kongo, with influence extending from the Atlantic toward the Kwango River.
simp_chinese: 姆班扎姆彭巴属于历史上的刚果王国。广大王国由姆韦内刚果统治下的多个核心省份组成，其影响力从大西洋向宽果河延伸。

english: Mbanza Nsundi stands by the Inkisi River and was the capital of Nsundi province. Local traditions recalled Nsundi as an earlier independent kingdom before its absorption into Kongo in the fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 姆班扎恩送迪位于因基西河旁，曾是恩送迪省的首府。地方传统认为恩送迪原是独立小国，15世纪被纳入刚果王国。

english: Mbanza Soyo stands near the mouth of the Congo. Soyo was already a province of Kongo when the Portuguese arrived in 1482, governed by a mwene Soyo. It later became independent and played an influential role during Kongo’s seventeenth-century civil wars.
simp_chinese: 姆班扎索约位于刚果河口附近。1482年葡萄牙人抵达时，索约已是刚果王国的省份，由姆韦内索约治理。后来它获得独立，并在十七世纪刚果内战期间发挥重要影响。

english: Mbara belongs to the Indigenous linguistic landscape of Queensland. Mbara appears among the southern languages in classifications of the wider Paman group, alongside Mbabaram and Walangama. Scholars differ over the relationships among these Australian language branches.
simp_chinese: 姆巴拉属于昆士兰原住民的语言地域。在广义帕马语言分类中，姆巴拉与姆巴巴拉姆、瓦兰加马一同列入南部分支。学者对这些澳大利亚语言分支之间的亲缘关系仍有不同判断。

english: The southeastern African coast faces the Indian Ocean. The wider region is crossed by major river systems, including the Zambezi, which reaches the ocean farther north in Mozambique.
simp_chinese: 非洲东南海岸面向印度洋。广阔的腹地分布着多条大河，其中赞比西河在更北方的莫桑比克注入印度洋。

english: Mbegela belongs to the Benguela country of western Angola. The later Portuguese city was founded in 1617 as São Felipe de Benguela and became a center of trade, including the trafficking of enslaved people to Brazil and Cuba. Nearby Baía Farta supported salt making and sulphur extraction.
simp_chinese: 姆贝格拉属于安哥拉西部的本格拉地区。后来的葡萄牙城市于1617年以圣费利佩·德本格拉之名创建，成为贸易中心，包括将奴隶贩运至巴西与古巴。附近拜亚法尔塔则从事制盐与硫磺开采。

english: The Mbegela Coast belongs to the Atlantic maritime setting around Luanda. In the wider Angolan region, trade through Portuguese ports at Luanda and Benguela later helped spread maize and cassava, changing regional food production.
simp_chinese: 姆贝格拉海岸属于罗安达周边的大西洋海洋地带。在更广阔的安哥拉地区，经罗安达和本格拉葡萄牙港口进行的贸易后来帮助传播玉米与木薯，改变了区域粮食生产。

english: Mbegua belongs to the wider Paraná delta world. The lower river divides into arms and creates islands and wetlands between Entre Ríos, Santa Fe and Buenos Aires before entering the Río de la Plata; its alluvial channels form a changing landscape of water and sediment.
simp_chinese: 姆贝瓜属于广义的巴拉那三角洲地区。下游河流分成支汊，在恩特雷里奥斯、圣菲与布宜诺斯艾利斯之间形成岛屿和湿地，再汇入拉普拉塔河；冲积水道构成水流与泥沙不断改变的景观。

english: Mbeiwum belongs to the broader Indigenous language world of Cape York in Queensland. The peninsula is home to the Paman languages, a diverse group notable for substantial sound changes among its branches.
simp_chinese: 姆贝伍姆属于昆士兰约克角更广阔的原住民语言世界。半岛上分布着帕马诸语言，这一多样的语言群以各分支之间显著的语音变化为特点。

english: Mbewe belongs to the wider Shire valley, part of the East African Rift system. The Shire is Lake Malawi’s only outlet and flows south to join the Zambezi in Mozambique. Below its middle falls and gorges, the river enters low plains and passes through the Elephant Marsh.
simp_chinese: 姆贝韦属于广义希雷河谷，是东非裂谷系统的一部分。希雷河是马拉维湖唯一出口，向南流至莫桑比克汇入赞比西河。穿过中游瀑布与峡谷后，河流进入低平原，并经过大象沼泽。

english: Mbia belongs to the Chiquitania country of eastern Bolivia. The wider region consists of tropical savannas and historically supported many languages, including Chiquitano, Ayoreo, Guarani and Otuke.
simp_chinese: 姆比亚属于玻利维亚东部的奇基塔尼亚地区。更广阔的区域由热带稀树草原构成，历史上使用多种语言，包括奇基塔诺、阿约雷奥、瓜拉尼与奥图克语。

english: Mbinga belongs to the Rufiji country within the wider Swahili coastal region of East Africa. Along that coast, farming, fishing and pastoral communities developed alongside trading societies that absorbed influences from across the Indian Ocean.
simp_chinese: 姆宾加属于东非斯瓦希里沿海大区域中的鲁菲吉地区。沿海的农耕、渔业和牧养社群与贸易社会共同发展，并吸收来自印度洋各地的影响。

english: Mboma belongs to the broader Angolan interior associated with Viye. In the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, Viye stood at a crossroads linking Central and Southern African trade.
simp_chinese: 姆博马属于与维耶相联系的广阔安哥拉内陆。在十八和十九世纪，维耶位于连接中部与南部非洲贸易的交汇点。

english: The country around Mbombela lies along the Crocodile River in the northeastern South African Lowveld. San rock art and Iron Age remains reveal a history far older than the modern city: archaeological work uncovered farming settlements, storage pits, burials and pottery dating from the sixth to the seventeenth centuries. These traces place cultivated fields and settled communities within the landscape long before its colonial urban growth. The town called Nelspruit developed only in the late nineteenth century, becoming a stop on the railway linking the Witwatersrand goldfields with Delagoa Bay. Mbombela, a Siswati name associated with people gathered closely together, later became the city's official name.
simp_chinese: 姆邦贝拉周围位于南非东北部低地草原的鳄鱼河沿岸。桑人岩画与铁器时代遗存揭示了远早于现代城市的历史：考古工作发现了六至十七世纪的农业聚落、储藏坑、墓葬及陶器。这些遗迹表明，在殖民城镇兴起之前，当地早已有耕地与定居社区。名为内尔斯普雷特的城镇直到十九世纪后期才发展起来，成为连接威特沃特斯兰德金矿与德拉戈阿湾的铁路停靠点。姆邦贝拉这一斯瓦蒂语名称与人群紧密聚集的含义有关，后来成为城市的正式名称。

english: Mbombona belongs to the wider Zambezi river country. The great river flows from Zambia through a succession of southern African borderlands before crossing Mozambique to the Indian Ocean.
simp_chinese: 姆邦博纳属于广阔的赞比西河地区。这条大河从赞比亚流出，穿过非洲南部的一系列边境地带，再横越莫桑比克汇入印度洋。

english: Mbondo belongs to the mountainous country around Mbwila in present-day Angola. The wider Mbwila region controlled a gap at the headwaters of the Lukala, where a trade route connected the lands of Kongo and Ndongo.
simp_chinese: 姆邦多属于今日安哥拉姆布维拉周边的山地区域。更广阔的姆布维拉地区控制卢卡拉河源头的山间缺口，一条贸易路线经此连接刚果与恩东戈。

english: Mbosaksawaas belongs to the Klamath country of southern Oregon and northern California. Klamath communities lived around Upper Klamath Lake and the Williamson, Wood and Sprague rivers, drawing much of their food from fish, roots and seeds. These inland waters anchored a way of life within the Plateau cultural world.
simp_chinese: 姆博萨克萨瓦斯属于俄勒冈南部与加利福尼亚北部的克拉马斯人地域。克拉马斯社区居于上克拉马斯湖及威廉森河、伍德河和斯普拉格河周边，食物主要来自鱼类、根茎与种子。这些内陆水域支撑着高原文化圈中的一种生活方式。

english: Mboune belongs to the Jolof country of Senegal. From the fourteenth century, the Wolof empire brought Wolof, Serer and Fula communities into a wider political order; after the battle of Danki in 1549, its former vassal states became independent.
simp_chinese: 姆布内属于塞内加尔的乔洛夫地域。十四世纪起，沃洛夫帝国将沃洛夫、塞雷尔与富拉社群纳入广阔的政治体系；1549年丹基战役后，其旧属邦纷纷独立。

english: Mbridge belongs to the Kongo setting of Central Africa. In the wider region, Bantu migrants had reached the lands of present-day Angola by the middle of the first millennium BCE, part of a much longer history of settlement and movement.
simp_chinese: 姆布里奇属于中非的刚果地区。从更广阔的区域看，班图移民在公元前一千纪中叶已经到达今安哥拉一带，这是当地更漫长定居与迁徙历史的一部分。

english: The Mbunga are a Bantu-speaking people of Tanzania. Their communities are found in the Iringa and Morogoro regions, including the country around Kilolo.
simp_chinese: 姆本加人是坦桑尼亚的一支班图语群体。社群分布于伊林加与莫罗戈罗地区，包括基洛洛周边地带。

english: Mbwela Kabango belongs to the broader Viye setting of central Angola. The kingdom’s position on the plateau helped it serve as a commercial crossroads, while its kings and nobles competed for authority in the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries.
simp_chinese: 姆布韦拉卡班戈属于安哥拉中部广义维耶地区。王国在高原上的位置使其成为商业交汇地，十八世纪末至十九世纪初国王与贵族之间则存在权力竞争。

english: Mbya belongs to the wider Ivaí landscape of southern Brazil. The Ivaí valley in Paraná has a humid subtropical setting, with higher country remaining moist throughout the year.
simp_chinese: 姆比亚位于巴西南部更广阔的伊瓦伊地区。巴拉那州的伊瓦伊河谷属于湿润的亚热带环境，高地全年保持湿润。

english:
Mchinji lies in the uplands west of Lilongwe, close to the frontier between present-day Malawi and Zambia. The surrounding countryside depends chiefly on rain-fed agriculture, with groundnuts, tobacco, soya and cassava among its crops. Chichewa is the principal local language, alongside other languages spoken in neighbouring communities.

The town's later administrative centre was known in the colonial era as Fort Manning, named for Governor William Manning. Its title recalled the fortified government enclosure, or boma, rather than an ancient stone citadel. Modern roads and railways subsequently made Mchinji a border gateway, but cultivation and the seasonal availability of rain continued to shape the wider district's daily life.
simp_chinese:
姆钦吉位于利隆圭以西的高地，靠近今天马拉维与赞比亚之间的边境。周围乡村主要依靠雨养农业，出产花生、烟草、大豆和木薯等作物。奇契瓦语是当地主要语言，邻近社群也使用其他语言。

城镇后来形成的行政中心在殖民时期称曼宁堡，得名于总督威廉·曼宁。“堡”这一称呼来自设有防御设施的政府驻地，即博马，并非古代石砌城堡。现代公路与铁路随后使姆钦吉成为边境门户，但耕作和季节性降雨仍塑造着广大地区的日常生活。

english: The McIvor coastal sector belongs to northern Australia’s tropical setting. Across the wider north, hot and humid monsoon summers shape the environment, while major coastal landscapes include the Great Barrier Reef and the wetlands of Kakadu.
simp_chinese: 麦基弗河口所在沿海地带属于澳大利亚北部的热带环境。广义北部地区的夏季炎热潮湿，受季风影响；大堡礁与卡卡杜湿地都是这一地区重要的沿海景观。

english: The waters around McTavish Island belong to Hudson Bay’s eastern coastal system. The bay lies west of Quebec and collects rivers from a vast continental basin. Hudson Strait provides its principal northeastern route toward the Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 麦克塔维什岛周边水域属于哈得孙湾东部海岸系统。海湾位于魁北克以西，汇集广大大陆流域的河流。哈得孙海峡提供东北方向通往大西洋的主要路线。

english: The Mealy Mountains extend south of Lake Melville in Labrador. Their varied uplands contain tundra, boreal forests, coastal barrens and bogs.
simp_chinese: 米利山在拉布拉多梅尔维尔湖以南展开。多样的山地包含苔原、北方森林、沿海荒原与沼泽。

english: Meaux stands on the Marne in the Brie country east of Paris. Its name preserves that of the Meldi, the Gaulish people of the valley, although the Roman town was called Iantinum. A river bend divides the old settlement between the cathedral quarter, with its episcopal palace, and the market quarter to the south. The Cornillon Canal, built in 1235, belongs to this long history of river traffic. Henry V's English army besieged Meaux in 1421–1422 during the Hundred Years' War. Religious conflict later left another mark: fourteen members of a Reformed congregation were burned in 1546. Alongside these struggles, the town's cheese and mustard gave Meaux a reputation tied to the produce of its countryside.
simp_chinese: 莫城坐落于巴黎以东布里地区的马恩河畔。城名保存着谷地高卢部族梅尔迪人的名字，尽管罗马城镇曾称扬蒂努姆。河流曲折处将旧城分成两部分：一边是拥有主教宫的大教堂区，南边则为市场区。建于1235年的科尔尼永运河，也属于这里悠久的水运历史。百年战争期间，亨利五世的英军于1421至1422年围攻莫城。宗教冲突后来又留下伤痕：1546年，改革宗会众中的14人遭受火刑。争斗之外，当地奶酪与芥末也让莫城以周边乡土的物产而闻名。

english: Mebengokre refers to the “people from the water’s source,” a wider Indigenous nation including the Kayapo. Their country extends across Pará and Mato Grosso south of the Amazon, particularly along the Xingu and its tributaries.
simp_chinese: 梅本戈克雷意为“水源之民”，是包括卡亚波人在内的广义原住民族群。其土地横跨亚马逊河以南的帕拉与马托格罗索，尤其分布于欣古河及其支流沿岸。

english: Mécatina belongs to the Québec region of Canada. The wider region formed the French colony of Canada before passing to British rule after the Seven Years’ War.
simp_chinese: 梅卡蒂纳属于加拿大魁北克地区。更广阔的魁北克地区曾构成法属加拿大殖民地，七年战争后转入英国统治。

english: The Mecatina Hills belong to the broader Quebec region of northeastern North America. This extensive territory adjoins Labrador and faces northern waters along the eastern side of Canada.
simp_chinese: 梅卡蒂纳丘陵属于北美东北部的魁北克地区。这片广大地域毗邻拉布拉多，并沿加拿大东侧面向北方水域。

english: Quebec’s eastern island waters open toward Canada’s Atlantic coast. The neighbouring mainland became part of New France before British control followed in the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 魁北克东部岛屿水域通向加拿大大西洋海岸。邻近大陆曾属新法兰西，十八世纪转归英国控制。

english: The Mécatina uplands form part of the river country between Labrador and Quebec’s north shore. The Little Mécatina rises near Lake Aticonac, close to the watershed of the Atlantic and St Lawrence basins, before winding southeast toward the Gulf of St Lawrence.
simp_chinese: 梅卡蒂纳高地属于拉布拉多与魁北克北岸之间的河流地域。小梅卡蒂纳河发源于阿蒂科纳克湖附近，靠近大西洋与圣劳伦斯流域的分水岭，再蜿蜒向东南流入圣劳伦斯湾。

english: Mecca occupies a valley in the mountains of the Hejaz, inland from the Red Sea port of Jeddah. The Kaaba forms the focus of Muslim prayer and pilgrimage, while the Sacred Mosque contains the Zamzam Well and the routes of rites associated with Safa and Marwa. Receiving the annual gathering of pilgrims made water supply a question of enduring importance. Zubayda, wife of the Abbasid caliph Harun al-Rashid, funded wells and conduits to serve the city, and later rulers repeatedly repaired this system. In 1517 the sharif acknowledged Ottoman supremacy while retaining considerable local autonomy. Control of the sanctuary passed through further conflict when the First Saudi State occupied Mecca in 1803, before Muhammad Ali's forces restored Ottoman control in 1813.
simp_chinese: 麦加坐落在汉志群山间的谷地，位于红海港口吉达内陆。克尔白是穆斯林礼拜与朝觐的中心，禁寺内则有渗渗泉，以及与萨法、麦尔沃两处高地相关的仪式路线。每年接待汇聚而来的朝觐者，使供水成为长期重要的问题。阿拔斯哈里发哈伦·拉希德之妻祖拜达出资修建水井与引水设施，后世统治者又反复修缮这一系统。1517年，麦加谢里夫承认奥斯曼的宗主地位，同时保有相当程度的地方自治。圣地的控制权此后再经战火：第一沙特国家于1803年占领麦加，穆罕默德·阿里的军队则在1813年恢复奥斯曼的统治。

english: Mechelen stands on the Dyle between Brussels and Antwerp. The river gave the Flemish city its familiar name of Dijlestad, while its surrounding municipality joins the urban center to hamlets and villages such as Battel, Walem and Muizen.
simp_chinese: 梅赫伦位于布鲁塞尔与安特卫普之间的代勒河畔。河流赋予这座佛兰德城市“代勒之城”的俗称，周边地域则将城市中心与巴特尔、瓦勒姆和默伊曾等村落连接起来。

english: Mechet belongs to the lower Don river country of the Pontic steppe. The Don curves through southern Russia to the Sea of Azov and historically carried trade connected with the Byzantine world.
simp_chinese: 梅切特属于黑海草原的顿河下游地区。顿河曲折穿过俄罗斯南部，流入亚速海，历史上承载着与拜占庭世界相联系的贸易。

english: Mechetnaya belongs to the Pontic–Caspian steppe near its eastern reaches. The wider grassland belt extends from the Black Sea toward the northern Caspian and joins the Kazakh steppe through the Ural-Caspian narrowing.
simp_chinese: 梅切特纳亚属于黑海—里海草原靠东的地区。更广阔的草原带从黑海延向里海北部，并经乌拉尔—里海狭窄地带与哈萨克草原相接。

english: Mechigmenskiy Zaliv belongs to the eastern coastal world of the Chukchi Peninsula. Across the wider peninsula, the Chukchi Sea lies north and the Bering Sea south, while the narrow Bering Strait separates Asia from Alaska. Inland mountains occupy much of the central and western country.
simp_chinese: 梅奇格门斯基湾属于楚科奇半岛东部沿海地区。在更广阔的半岛范围，北面为楚科奇海，南面为白令海，狭窄的白令海峡将亚洲与阿拉斯加分隔。内陆山地占据中西部大片地区。

english: Mechili stands in the desert of Cyrenaica, east of Benghazi and west of Timimi, at the site of a former Turkish fort. Its isolated position gave it a very different character from the Mediterranean ports farther north. A much later chapter made the village a repeatedly contested point in the North African campaigns of the Second World War. British forces took it in January 1941, an Italian armoured formation captured the garrison that April, and further changes of possession followed in 1941 and 1942. The paving of the Charruba–Timimi road in the late twentieth century finally reduced the village's old isolation.
simp_chinese: 迈基利位于昔兰尼加沙漠中，处在班加西以东、蒂米米以西，所在地曾有一座土耳其堡垒。孤立的地理位置，使其面貌迥异于更北方的地中海港口。到了远为晚近的第二次世界大战北非战役，这座村落又成为反复争夺的据点。英军于1941年1月占领这里，当年4月，一支意大利装甲部队俘获驻军，此后1941至1942年间又数度易手。二十世纪后期沙鲁巴至蒂米米公路铺设完成，才减轻了村落长期以来的隔绝。

english: Mechiso belongs to the broader Keewatin country west of Hudson Bay. The later administrative territory was created in 1876 and repeatedly reduced as provincial boundaries expanded. Its northern remainder became part of Nunavut in 1999.
simp_chinese: 梅奇索属于哈德森湾以西广义基韦廷地区。后来设立的行政领地建于1876年，随着省界扩展多次缩小。其北部余域于1999年成为努纳武特的一部分。

english: The Mechoopda are a Maidu people whose earlier village stood south of modern Chico in California. Their traditional speech is Konkow, related to the Maidu language.
simp_chinese: 梅乔普达人属于迈杜人，早期村落位于今加利福尼亚奇科以南。他们传统上使用孔科语，与迈杜语有亲缘关系。

english: The southern Gulf of Mexico borders the low coasts of Tabasco, Campeche and Yucatán. Its relatively narrow ocean connections help keep tides small across the wider gulf.
simp_chinese: 墨西哥湾南部邻接塔巴斯科、坎佩切与尤卡坦的低平海岸。相对狭窄的外洋通道，使整个海湾潮差较小。

english: Mecumba belongs to the wider Ambundu cultural region of north-central Angola. Kimbundu-speaking communities occupy the plateau north of the Kwanza and lands east of Luanda. The title Ngola, used by the head of their principal kingdom, gave Angola its name.
simp_chinese: 梅昆巴属于安哥拉中北部广阔的安本杜文化地区。使用金本杜语的社群分布于宽扎河以北高原和卢安达以东地域。其主要王国首领使用Ngola称号，安哥拉国名即由此而来。

english: Mêda belongs to the Beira interior of northern Portugal. The surrounding municipality contains the castle of Marialva, while the prehistoric rock art of the Côa valley lies nearby in neighbouring Foz Côa and Pinhel.
simp_chinese: 梅达属于葡萄牙北部的贝拉内陆。周围市域内有马里阿尔瓦城堡，邻近的科阿新镇与皮涅尔地区则保存着科阿河谷史前岩画。

english:
Medak stands on the Telangana plateau, about 442 meters above sea level. An older name, Methukudurgam, recalled the grain grown here, tying the town's identity to rice cultivation. Agriculture has remained central to the surrounding country.

The fort gives Medak a second, martial identity. It was first built by the Kakatiya kings and subsequently developed by the Qutb Shahi rulers, preserving the succession of two powers that shaped this part of the Deccan. Near the town, the temple of Kuchadri Venkateshwara Swamy at Kuchanpally supplies another longstanding focus of worship alongside the fortified height.
simp_chinese:
梅达克位于特伦甘纳高原，海拔约442米。旧称“梅图库杜尔加姆”使人联想到这里出产的谷物，将城镇的身份与水稻种植联系起来。农业长期是周围乡间的重要生计。

堡垒则赋予梅达克另一层军事色彩。它最初由卡卡提亚诸王修建，后来又由库特布沙希统治者扩建，留下了两个塑造这片德干地区的政权相继统治的痕迹。附近库昌帕利村的库查德里·文卡特斯瓦拉斯瓦米神庙，与设防高地一道，构成了当地长久以来的信仰与地景中心。

english: Medanapalle belongs to the wider Andhra country of southern India. Telugu is the region’s principal language, while ancient accounts connect the Andhras with the Krishna and Godavari river deltas.
simp_chinese: 马达纳帕勒属于印度南部更广阔的安得拉地区。泰卢固语是当地主要语言，古代记载则将安得拉人与克里希纳河、戈达瓦里河三角洲联系起来。

english: Medawachchiya lies in Sri Lanka's dry zone, near Anuradhapura, at a meeting of routes toward Jaffna, Mannar, Kandy and Trincomalee. This position gives the locality connections both to the northern peninsula and to the island's western and eastern coasts. Its familiar role as a railway junction belongs to the modern era, when the Northern and Mannar lines met here. Much later, the civil war interrupted the Mannar route and destroyed stretches of the northern network, while track around Medawachchiya survived. Passenger trains returned to the section between the town and Madhu Road in 2013. These later railways made especially visible the importance of this crossroads in the north-central dry country.
simp_chinese: 梅达沃奇亚位于斯里兰卡干燥地带，邻近阿努拉德普勒，是通往贾夫纳、马纳尔、康提和亭可马里的路线交汇处。这一位置使当地同时联系着北部半岛和岛屿东西两侧海岸。它作为铁路枢纽的熟悉身份属于现代，北方线与马纳尔线在此相接。更晚近的内战中，马纳尔路线中断，北方铁路网的若干区段遭毁，而梅达沃奇亚周围的铁轨得以幸存。2013年，城镇至马杜路的一段恢复客运。这些后来的铁路，格外鲜明地展现了这处中北部旱区十字路口的重要性。

english: Médéa stands in the uplands south of Algiers, surrounded by hills bearing grain fields, orchards and vineyards. The site had a Roman settlement called Lamdia, whose Donatist bishop Felix attended the Conference of Carthage in 411. The later town became a seat of power in the Ottoman regency: the Beylik of Titteri was established in 1548, with its bey residing at Médéa as deputy of the Dey of Algiers. Its last bey, Mostefa Boumezrag, governed from 1819 until the French arrival in 1830. Under the Treaty of Tafna in 1837, Médéa became one of the capitals of the country ruled by Abdelkader, before subsequent French occupation. These changes made the highland town a recurring centre of regional administration and military authority.
simp_chinese: 麦迪亚位于阿尔及尔以南的高地，周围山丘分布着谷田、果园与葡萄园。古罗马时期，这里有一处名为拉姆迪亚的聚落，其多纳图斯派主教费利克斯参加了411年的迦太基会议。后来的城镇成为奥斯曼摄政领的权力中心之一：提特里贝伊辖区于1548年设立，贝伊驻于麦迪亚，作为阿尔及尔迪伊的代理人治理地方。末代贝伊穆斯塔法·布梅兹拉格从1819年执政，直到1830年法国人到来。1837年《塔夫纳条约》签订后，麦迪亚成为阿卜杜勒卡迪尔统治地区的都城之一，后来又被法国占领。这些变迁使这座高地城镇反复成为区域行政与军事权力的中心。

english: Medellín belongs to Extremadura in western Iberia. The wider region is crossed by the Tagus and Guadiana, and formed part of Roman Lusitania, whose capital stood at Mérida.
simp_chinese: 麦德林属于伊比利亚西部埃斯特雷马杜拉。塔霍河与瓜迪亚纳河穿越更广阔的区域，该地曾属罗马卢西塔尼亚行省，行省首府位于梅里达。

english: Medenine stands in southeastern Tunisia on the road towards Libya, south of Gabès and the island of Djerba. Before colonial rule it was already a leading trading centre of the Tunisian south, drawing merchants from across North Africa and even from Bornu beyond the Sahara. Its ksar contained the central granaries of the region's nomadic Berber communities. These stores gave the settlement a role that reached beyond its resident population, bringing the needs of mobile pastoral societies together with those of long-distance merchants. The town's commercial importance thus rested on both its position along the route east and its service to the communities of the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 梅德宁位于突尼斯东南部、加贝斯和杰尔巴岛以南，坐落在通往利比亚的道路上。殖民统治到来之前，它已是突尼斯南部的重要贸易中心，吸引着北非各地的商人，甚至有来自撒哈拉以南博尔努的贸易者。当地的克萨尔建筑群容纳着周边游牧柏柏尔社群的集中粮仓。这些储粮设施使聚落的作用远远超出常住人口的需要，将流动牧民社群与长途商人的活动汇集在一起。城镇的商业地位，既依靠向东延伸的交通路线，也依靠它为周围地区各社群提供的服务。

english: Mediaș grew in the valley of the Târnava Mare, where Hungarian kings encouraged the settlement of Transylvanian Saxons in the thirteenth century. Its name descends from the Hungarian word for sour cherry, passing through German into Romanian. A document of 1267 names the settlement Mediesy, and another of 1283 calls it villa Medgyes; by 1359 it was described as a civitas. Royal privileges tied the community to the rights of the Sibiu region. Its inhabitants and those of Șeica Mare fortified the town between 1490 and 1534, while the right to hold annual fairs, granted in 1517, strengthened its commercial life. Thirty-four guilds were recorded in 1562. Fortifications and prosperous crafts did not remove the hazards of the age: plague repeatedly struck the town, and Gabriel Báthory's soldiers plundered it in 1611.
simp_chinese: 梅迪亚什在大特尔纳瓦河谷发展起来，匈牙利国王于十三世纪鼓励特兰西瓦尼亚萨克森人迁居此地。城名源自匈牙利语中意为酸樱桃的词，经过德语传入罗马尼亚语。1267年的文书称聚落为Mediesy，1283年的另一份文书则写作villa Medgyes；到1359年，它已被称作civitas。王室特权使当地社区与锡比乌地区的权利体系相连。1490至1534年间，本地居民与谢伊卡马雷的居民共同修筑城防；1517年获得的年度集市权又加强了商业生活。1562年有三十四个行会见于记录。但坚固城防与繁荣手工业仍无法消除时代的危险：瘟疫屡次侵袭，1611年加布里埃尔·巴托里的士兵又洗劫了城镇。

english: Medicina lies in the agricultural lowlands east of Bologna, where Roman land division left traces in roads, drainage and the pattern of fields. The medieval settlement developed as a fortified centre before coming under Bologna's growing authority. Later it passed through the domain of the Bentivoglio and, following their fall in 1506, into direct papal administration. Its name, meaning medicine in Italian, inspired a tale that Barbarossa recovered here after a snake fell into his soup. The name predates the emperor's visit, so the story belongs to the town's legends rather than its established origin.
simp_chinese: 梅迪奇纳位于博洛尼亚以东的农业低地，罗马时代的土地划分在道路、排水与田地格局中留下了痕迹。中世纪聚落发展为设防中心，随后纳入日益扩张的博洛尼亚权力之下。后来它属于本蒂沃利奥家族的领地，并在该家族于1506年失势后，转由教廷直接管理。城名在意大利语中意为医药，因而衍生出一则传说：巴巴罗萨在此饮用了意外落入蛇的汤后痊愈。然而这一地名早于皇帝的来访，故事属于城镇传说，无法作为确切的名称起源。

english: Medicine Bow belongs to the High Plains setting east of the Rocky Mountains. This forms the western part of the broader Great Plains, whose grasslands were historically inhabited by immense bison herds and whose western reaches also support pronghorn.
simp_chinese: 梅迪辛博属于落基山脉以东的高平原地域。这里构成广大大平原的西部，草地历史上曾有庞大的野牛群，西部地区也分布着叉角羚。

english: Medina lies in the Hejaz region of western Arabia. Known as al-Madinah al-Munawwarah, the radiant city, it ranks after Mecca as Islam’s second holiest city.
simp_chinese: 麦地那位于阿拉伯半岛西部的汉志地区。它又称“光辉之城”，是伊斯兰教中仅次于麦加的第二圣城。

english: Medina de Rioseco lies in the Tierra de Campos near the Sequillo River. Settlement expanded during the Asturian-Leonese colonisation of the ninth and tenth centuries, in a country later contested between León and Castile. Its enduring identity as the City of the Admirals arose from the Enríquez family: Alonso Enríquez received the admiralty of Castile in 1405, and the lordship of Rioseco was established in 1423. Successive admirals secured fair privileges and sponsored churches, convents and a palace. Sixteenth-century commerce connected its fairs with silver arriving from the Americas through Seville, bringing wealth into local religious foundations. A town well inland thus shared in both Castile’s maritime offices and the Atlantic circulation of precious metal.
simp_chinese: 里奥塞科的梅迪纳位于塞基略河附近的田野之地。九至十世纪阿斯图里亚斯—莱昂王国拓殖时，当地聚落得到扩展，此后又处在莱昂与卡斯蒂利亚争夺的土地之间。它作为“海军上将之城”的长久身份，源于恩里克斯家族：阿隆索·恩里克斯于1405年获任卡斯蒂利亚海军上将，里奥塞科领地则于1423年确立。历任海军上将争取集市特权，资助教堂、修道院与宫邸。十六世纪的商业，将这里的集市与经塞维利亚进入的美洲白银相连，也为当地宗教机构带来财富。于是，这座深处内陆的城镇，既参与卡斯蒂利亚的海事官职体系，也分享了跨大西洋贵金属流通的收益。

english: Medina del Campo grew beside the Zapardiel in the Castilian interior. Repopulated after 1085, it became a walled center whose great fairs drew merchants from Portugal, Italy, Flanders, and beyond. Wool, cloth, books, and banking business filled its markets in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries; financiers gathered along the street later called Padilla, while other traders occupied allotted places around the main square. Above the town stood La Mota, both fortress and royal prison, where Cesare Borgia was among the captives. The royal palace was the setting of Isabella of Castile's final testament and death in 1504. During the Comunero revolt, resistance to a royalist attempt to seize the town's artillery ended in a devastating fire.
simp_chinese: 梅迪纳德尔坎波位于卡斯蒂利亚内陆的萨帕尔迭尔河畔。1085年以后这里重新迁入人口，发展成一座有城墙的中心城镇，盛大的集市吸引了来自葡萄牙、意大利、佛兰德斯及更远地区的商人。十五至十六世纪，羊毛、布匹、书籍与银行业务充满市场；金融商人聚集在后来称为帕迪利亚的街道，其他商贩则依照分配占据主广场周围的位置。镇上方的拉莫塔兼作要塞与王家监狱，切萨雷·博尔贾也曾囚禁于此。卡斯蒂利亚的伊莎贝拉于1504年在当地王宫立下最后遗嘱，并在此去世。公社起义期间，保王派企图夺取城中的火炮，居民抵抗，最终引发了一场毁灭性大火。

english: Medina Sidonia rises on a hill inland from Cádiz, a position that repeatedly made it a defensive stronghold. It is generally identified with ancient Asido, whose coins carried both Latin and Punic inscriptions alongside images of Herakles and dolphins. A Phoenician foundation has been proposed, and the name Sidonia preserves a traditional association with Sidon. Visigothic King Liuvigild took the town from the Byzantines in 571; Muslim conquest followed in 712, and Sidonia became a provincial centre of al-Andalus. Alfonso X brought it under Castilian rule in 1264, turning it into a fortress on the frontier with Granada and a seat of military orders. In 1440 it entered the lordship of the dukes of Medina Sidonia. The ducal name later became inseparable from a much wider maritime venture: the seventh duke, Alonso Pérez de Guzmán, commanded the Spanish Armada against England in 1588.
simp_chinese: 锡多尼亚城耸立在加的斯内陆的山丘上，这一位置使它屡次成为防御据点。它通常被认作古代的阿西多，其钱币同时带有拉丁文与布匿文铭文，并饰以赫拉克勒斯和海豚图案。有学者提出它可能由腓尼基人创建，锡多尼亚之名也保留了与西顿相联系的传统。571年，西哥特国王利乌维吉尔德从拜占庭手中夺取城镇；712年穆斯林征服随后而至，锡多尼亚成为安达卢斯的行省中心。1264年，阿方索十世将它纳入卡斯蒂利亚统治，使之成为面对格拉纳达的边疆堡垒，并成为军事修会驻地。1440年，它进入梅迪纳—锡多尼亚公爵的领地。这个公爵名号后来又与一场远为广阔的海上行动相连：第七代公爵阿隆索·佩雷斯·德·古斯曼在1588年统率西班牙无敌舰队进攻英格兰。

english:
Medinaceli commands the Jalón valley from a hilltop in the lands of Soria. Its earlier identity was the Celtiberian town of Occilis, while its present name recalls the Berber Banū Sālim lineage established here under Islamic rule. Even after that family was defeated in 920, the town retained its military importance to Córdoba.

In 946 Medinaceli became the headquarters of the Middle March, serving as a base for operations towards the upper Duero and against the rebellious Banū Tujib. Older and later monuments share the same heights: a Roman arch with three openings survives alongside a gate of the Islamic walls. The castle subsequently housed the dukes of Medinaceli before their residence moved to the ducal palace, adding aristocratic grandeur to a place long valued for its commanding position.
simp_chinese:
梅迪纳塞利居于索里亚地区的山顶，俯瞰哈隆河谷。它更早的身份是凯尔特伊比利亚城镇奥基利斯，现名则使人想起伊斯兰统治时期定居于此的柏柏尔巴努·萨利姆家族。即使这个家族在920年被击败，城镇对科尔多瓦仍具有军事重要性。

946年，梅迪纳塞利成为中部边区的首府，是向杜罗河上游进军以及镇压巴努·图吉卜叛乱的基地。更早和更晚的建筑同处这片高地：三孔罗马拱门留存至今，伊斯兰时期城墙的一座门也仍然可见。此后，梅迪纳塞利公爵曾居住于城堡，后来才将住所迁往公爵宫，为这处长期以居高临下地势见重的地方增添了贵族的气派。

english: Medininkai, now Varniai, was once the capital of the Duchy of Samogitia. The wider region occupies northwestern Lithuania and formed one of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania’s two core divisions. Its distinctive language and cultural traditions persisted through the centuries.
simp_chinese: 梅迪宁凯即今瓦尔尼艾，曾为萨莫吉蒂亚公国首府。广义萨莫吉蒂亚位于立陶宛西北，是立陶宛大公国两个核心区划之一。当地独特语言与文化传统历经数世纪延续。

english: Medininkai grew beside a fortress on the route from Vilnius towards Ashmyany. Its beginnings are debated, but the castle is securely recorded in 1385, when forces of the Teutonic Order captured it. Jogaila founded one of Lithuania's first seven Catholic churches here in 1387, making the place part of the duchy's new religious infrastructure. Another Teutonic raid burned the stronghold in 1402. In the fifteenth century the castle gained importance under Vytautas and later served as a residence for Casimir and his sons. Trade also brought income: a document of 1486 records two profitable inns. The first notice of Tatars settled near the castle dates to 1488, adding another community to this ducal stopping place.
simp_chinese: 梅迪宁凯在维尔纽斯通往奥什米亚内的道路旁，依托一座堡垒成长。城堡的起源仍有争论，但1385年条顿骑士团军队攻占它的记录已获可靠确认。1387年，雅盖沃在这里设立了立陶宛最早的七座天主教堂之一，将此地纳入大公国新建的宗教体系。1402年，条顿骑士团又一次袭击并烧毁堡垒。十五世纪，城堡在维陶塔斯统治下日益重要，后来还成为卡齐米日及其诸子的居所。贸易同样带来收入：1486年的一份文书记载了两座盈利丰厚的旅店。1488年首次出现鞑靼人在城堡附近定居的记载，为这处大公停驻之地增添了另一群居民。

english: Medjez el Bab lies on the Medjerda plain in northern Tunisia. Known as Membressa under Rome, it occupies a meeting of roads across the plain.
simp_chinese: 迈贾兹巴卜位于突尼斯北部的迈杰尔达平原。罗马时期称门布雷萨，坐落于穿越平原的道路交会处。

english: Mednoye is a rural settlement in the Tver region of Russia. The village belongs to the Kalininsky district and the surrounding Mednovskoye community.
simp_chinese: 梅德诺耶是俄罗斯特维尔地区的一处乡村聚落。村庄属于加里宁辖区及周围的梅德诺夫斯科耶社群。

english: Medonho belongs to the Gurguéia river country of northeastern Brazil. Flowing north toward the Parnaíba, the river drains a basin dominated by Cerrado savanna, with dry forest enclaves separating it from the Caatinga scrublands farther east.
simp_chinese: 梅多尼奥属于巴西东北部的古尔盖亚河地域。河流向北汇入帕尔纳伊巴河，流域以塞拉多稀树草原为主，干林斑块将其与更东面的卡廷加灌丛相分隔。

english: Medrissa lies in the northwestern interior of Algeria. It is both a town and a commune of Tiaret Province, forming one of the local administrative communities of that region.
simp_chinese: 梅德里萨位于阿尔及利亚西北内陆。它既是城镇，也是提亚雷特省的一个市镇，构成当地行政社群的一部分。

english: Meductic belongs to the Saint John River country of present-day New Brunswick. Until the eighteenth century, the historical village was the largest settlement of the Wolastoqiyik people, giving this riverside community a significance far beyond the size of the later municipality. Colonial warfare broke that continuity: the village was burned during the Saint John River campaign of 1758, amid the expulsion of the Acadians. The name endured along the river, preserving a connection to an Indigenous settlement whose history preceded the administrative boundaries of modern New Brunswick.
simp_chinese: 梅杜克蒂克位于今日新不伦瑞克的圣约翰河流域。直到18世纪，这座历史村落仍是沃拉斯托奎伊克人最大的聚落，使这处河畔社群的重要性远远超出后来小型行政村的规模。殖民战争打断了这种延续：1758年圣约翰河战役期间，在驱逐阿卡迪亚人的背景下，村落被焚毁。这个名称此后仍沿河流传，将人们与一处原住民聚落联系起来；它的历史早于现代新不伦瑞克的行政边界。

english: Meduxnekeag belongs to the wider Maine region of northeastern North America. This New England country faces the Gulf of Maine and adjoins New Brunswick and Quebec on its northern borderlands.
simp_chinese: 梅达克斯内基格属于北美东北部的缅因地区。这片新英格兰地域面向缅因湾，北部边地毗邻新不伦瑞克与魁北克。

english: Medveđa occupies a landscape with remains of the Roman settlement Idimum. Fourth-century architectural debris and traces of travel and postal stations reflect its position within the communications of Upper Moesia.
simp_chinese: 梅德韦贾所在地区保留着罗马聚落伊迪穆姆的遗迹。4世纪建筑残片以及旅行、邮驿设施的痕迹，反映出它在上默西亚交通网络中的位置。

english: Medvezhye Bay belongs to the Chukchi coastal waters of the Arctic. The surrounding Chukchi Sea lies between Wrangel Island and Alaska, with the Bering Strait at its southern limit linking these waters to the Pacific.
simp_chinese: 梅德韦日耶湾属于北冰洋的楚科奇沿岸海域。周围的楚科奇海位于弗兰格尔岛与阿拉斯加之间，南端的白令海峡使这片海水与太平洋相连。

english: Medvezh’ye Bay lies in the East Siberian Sea’s coastal waters near the Bear Islands region. The wider island group occupies the western end of Kolyma Gulf. Yakov Permyakov reported its silhouette in 1710 while voyaging from the Lena toward the Kolyma.
simp_chinese: 梅德韦日耶湾位于东西伯利亚海熊群岛地区附近的近岸水域。更广阔的群岛处于科雷马湾西端。1710年，雅科夫·佩尔米亚科夫从勒拿河航向科雷马河时记载了群岛的轮廓。

english: Medvezh'ye, 'Bear Lake', is a salt lake on the Ishim Plain. Marshy islands and peninsulas divide it into a larger western and smaller eastern basin linked by a narrow sound. Local legend connects its therapeutic mud with a bear that healed an injured paw in the water.
simp_chinese: 梅德韦日耶意为“熊湖”，是伊希姆平原上的盐湖。沼泽岛屿与半岛将其分为较大的西湖盆与较小的东湖盆，以狭窄水道连接。当地传说将疗养湖泥与一头在水中治愈伤爪的熊相联系。

english: Medyn stands on the Medynka, a river of the Oka basin, northwest of Kaluga. Its first recorded appearance dates to 1386, when the settlement passed from the principality of Smolensk to the grand duchy of Moscow. This early transfer places it within the long expansion of Muscovite authority across the lands to its west. For much of its later history it retained the village name Medynskoye, receiving town status only in 1776. The medieval settlement and the later administrative town therefore belong to different stages of the same river-side community.
simp_chinese: 梅登位于卡卢加西北，临奥卡河流域的梅登卡河而建。它首次见于记录是在1386年，当时聚落由斯摩棱斯克公国转归莫斯科大公国。这次早期易手，使它进入莫斯科向西部土地扩展统治的漫长进程。此后相当长时间里，它仍沿用梅登斯科耶这一村名，直到1776年才取得城市地位。中世纪聚落与后来的行政城镇，因此属于同一河畔社群发展的不同阶段。

english: Meelpaeg belongs to the interior country of Newfoundland. The wider island lies in the Atlantic, separated from mainland Labrador by the Strait of Belle Isle.
simp_chinese: 米尔佩格属于纽芬兰内陆。更广阔的岛屿位于大西洋，与大陆上的拉布拉多之间隔着贝尔岛海峡。

english: Mégantic belongs to the country that formed part of Lower Canada after 1791. The colony's name referred to its position downstream on the St Lawrence; its French colonial inheritance survived Britain's conquest in the Seven Years' War through retained laws and institutions.
simp_chinese: 梅冈蒂克属于1791年后下加拿大的地域。下加拿大之名指其位于圣劳伦斯河较下游的位置；英国在七年战争中征服此地后，法国殖民时期的部分传统仍通过保留的法律与制度延续下来。

english: Megion lies on the right bank of the Ob in western Siberia and was first mentioned in 1810. Its growth into an industrial town came much later, following the discovery of oil in the region during the twentieth century.
simp_chinese: 梅吉翁位于西西伯利亚鄂毕河右岸，1810年首次见于记载。直到二十世纪当地发现石油之后，它才逐渐发展为工业城镇。

english: Megiscane belongs to the broader country east of James Bay. The regional name Jamésie derives from that bay; in modern geography it forms part of Nord-du-Québec alongside Kativik and Eeyou Istchee, with Chibougamau its largest community.
simp_chinese: 梅吉斯坎属于詹姆斯湾以东的广大地区。地区名称詹姆西来自这一海湾；在现代地理中，它与卡蒂维克和伊尤伊斯特奇共同构成北魁北克，希布加莫为其最大聚落。

english: Megra belongs to the wider Novgorod Land of northern Russia. This historical territory developed into a republic with extensive trade connections through the Hanseatic world and the rest of Rus’, reaching toward the White Sea at its greatest extent before Moscow conquered the republic in 1478.
simp_chinese: 梅格拉属于俄罗斯北部广阔的诺夫哥罗德地区。这一历史地域发展为共和国，通过汉萨世界和罗斯各地保持广泛贸易，极盛时伸向白海，直至1478年共和国被莫斯科征服。

english: Meğri occupies the site of ancient Telmessos on the Lycian coast, where a Hellenistic theatre and rock-cut tombs recall the city's earlier life. By the tenth century it was known as Makri, a name taken from the island guarding the harbour entrance. The medieval town recovered commercial importance: a report of 1106 identifies it as a centre of perfume production, and thirteenth-century geographers describe a trading settlement with enlarged walls. It came under the Menteşe beylik in 1284 and entered the Ottoman Empire in 1424. Its harbour and successive Greek and Turkish names preserve the history of a coastal town rebuilt across several political and cultural worlds.
simp_chinese: 梅里位于吕基亚海岸的古城特尔梅索斯遗址上，希腊化剧场与岩凿墓葬使人想起它早年的城市生活。到十世纪，此地以马克里之名为人所知，名称源自守在港口入口的岛屿。中世纪城镇重新获得商业地位：1106年的记载将其列为香料制品生产中心，十三世纪地理著作则描述了一处城墙扩建的贸易聚落。1284年，此地归于门泰谢侯国，1424年并入奥斯曼帝国。港口及先后使用的希腊语、土耳其语名称，保存了这座海滨城镇在不同政治与文化世界中重建的历史。

english: Megrino is a village in the Vologda country southeast of Chagoda. It serves as the centre of the surrounding rural settlement, with the village of Gorka nearby.
simp_chinese: 梅格里诺是沃洛格达地区恰戈达东南的一处村庄。它是周边乡村行政区的中心，邻近戈尔卡村。

english: The Meherrin lived between the Piedmont and coastal plains along the Virginia–North Carolina borderlands. Their Iroquoian language connected them with peoples farther north, and many later joined the Haudenosaunee Confederacy and settled in Canada.
simp_chinese: 梅赫林人居住在弗吉尼亚与北卡罗来纳交界的山麓及滨海平原之间。他们使用易洛魁语族语言，与更北方族群存在联系，许多人后来加入豪德诺索尼联盟并迁居加拿大。

english: Mehetia is a young volcanic island east of Tahiti, crowned by a distinct crater. Tahitian oral tradition remembers it as a sacred stopping place for voyagers bound for New Zealand. The expedition of Pedro Fernández de Quirós sighted it in 1606 and named it Decena.
simp_chinese: 梅赫蒂亚是塔希提以东的一座年轻火山岛，岛顶有轮廓分明的火山口。塔希提口述传统将这里记作前往新西兰的航海者停留的神圣地点。1606年，佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的探险队望见该岛，并将其命名为德塞纳。

english: Mehetia is a young volcanic island east of Tahiti in the Society Islands. Its summit forms a distinct crater, and the island is associated with the Teahitia–Mehetia hotspot.
simp_chinese: 梅赫蒂阿是社会群岛中位于塔希提以东的一座年轻火山岛。山顶有明显的火山口，岛屿与特阿希蒂阿—梅赫蒂阿热点相关。

english: Mehin belongs to the Tocantins country of inland Brazil. The Tocantins and Araguaia together drain the largest watershed contained entirely within Brazil, while the broader region spans rainforest and savanna environments.
simp_chinese: 梅欣属于巴西内陆的托坎廷斯地区。托坎廷斯河与阿拉瓜亚河共同构成完全位于巴西境内的最大流域，而更广阔的区域横跨雨林与稀树草原环境。

english: Mehkar lies near the Painganga River in Vidarbha, amid the basalt country of the Deccan. Its prosperity once rested in part on weaving, especially fine dhotis, and the fortified town preserves a gate inscription dated 1488. The Ain-i-Akbari records Mehkar as the headquarters of a Mughal sarkar, reflecting its administrative importance. Armies also used it as a stopping place: Madhavrao Peshwa camped here in 1769 with the Nizam's minister Rukn-ud-Daula during operations against Janoji Bhonsle, and General Doveton did so in 1817. Ruined temple walls, a pillared rest house and shrines add further layers to the history of this agricultural and weaving centre.
simp_chinese: 梅卡尔位于维达尔巴的潘甘加河附近，周围是德干玄武岩地带。城镇昔日的繁荣部分来自织造业，尤其以精细的托蒂裹布著称；设防城镇的一座城门还保存着纪年为1488年的铭文。《阿克巴会典》记载梅卡尔为莫卧儿帝国一个萨尔卡尔行政区的首府，体现了它的行政地位。军队也曾在此驻扎：1769年，佩什瓦马达夫拉奥与尼扎姆的大臣鲁肯·乌德·道拉征讨贾诺吉·蓬斯勒时在这里设营，1817年多夫顿将军也曾驻此。残存的神庙墙体、有柱廊的旅舍和各处祠庙，又为这座农业与纺织中心增添了历史层次。

english:
Mehsi lies on the Budhi Gandak in the fertile plains of northern Bihar, southeast of Motihari. Its markets gather produce from the surrounding countryside, and orchards of litchi and mango give the river country a distinctive agricultural character. Alongside farming and fruit trading, the town is known for a traditional industry making mother-of-pearl buttons.

The shrine of the Sufi saint Mirza Halim Shah forms another centre of local life. Its annual Urs fair brings worshippers and traders together from the surrounding region. A later episode connected Mehsi with the Champaran movement: Gandhi received a public welcome at the railway station in April 1917, placing this agricultural market town on the route of a much wider political struggle.
simp_chinese:
梅西位于比哈尔北部肥沃平原上的布迪根德格河畔，在莫蒂哈里东南方向。镇中市场汇集周围乡村的农产，荔枝园和芒果园赋予河流地区鲜明的农业面貌。除耕作和水果贸易外，当地还以制造珍珠母纽扣的传统手工业闻名。

苏菲圣人米尔扎·哈利姆沙阿的陵祠，是地方生活的另一个中心。一年一度的乌尔斯庙会，将周边地区的朝拜者与商贩汇聚在一起。更晚的一段历史使梅西与查姆帕兰运动相连：1917年4月，甘地在铁路车站受到公众欢迎，让这座农业集镇进入了一场更广泛政治斗争的行程。

english: Meiganga is a town in Cameroon's Adamawa country. It lies around six and a half degrees north of the equator in the eastern part of this broad inland region.
simp_chinese: 梅冈加是喀麦隆阿达马瓦地区的一座城镇。它位于约北纬六度半，处在这片广阔内陆地区的东部。

english: Meinersen lies between the Oker and Aller rivers in Lower Saxony. The town serves a collective municipality that gathers several nearby villages within the Gifhorn country.
simp_chinese: 迈纳森位于下萨克森奥克河与阿勒河之间。城镇是一个联合市镇的中心，将吉夫霍恩地区的多个邻近村落联系起来。

english: Meiningen grew beside a ford of the Werra, between the Thuringian Forest and the Rhön. First recorded in 982, it was given by Emperor Henry II to the bishopric of Würzburg in 1008. Episcopal rule met repeated resistance: after gaining extensive autonomy in 1344, the townspeople fortified their settlement with double walls and three moats, and in 1432 destroyed the bishop's castle in an uprising. Cloth production later brought prosperity through linen and fustian weaving, dyeing and trade. The Thirty Years' War shattered this growth, but a new role followed when Meiningen became the capital of Saxe-Meiningen in 1680. The Elisabethenburg palace and a court orchestra gave the former cloth town a ducal character.
simp_chinese: 迈宁根在韦拉河的一处渡口旁发展起来，介于图林根森林与伦山之间。这里于982年首次见于文献，1008年由皇帝海因里希二世赐予维尔茨堡主教区。主教统治屡遭反抗：市民在1344年取得广泛自治权后，以双重城墙和三道壕沟加强防御，又于1432年的起义中摧毁主教的城堡。后来，亚麻与棉麻混纺织造、染色和布匹贸易带来繁荣。三十年战争打断了这番发展，但1680年迈宁根成为萨克森—迈宁根的首都，获得新的地位。伊丽莎白堡宫与宫廷乐团，为昔日的布业城镇增添了公爵驻地的风貌。

english: Meiqiu belongs to the Suizhou country of northern Hubei. In the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods, the wider area formed the territory of Sui or Zeng within the cultural sphere of Chu. Excavations at Yejiashan have illuminated this ancient regional world.
simp_chinese: 梅丘属于湖北北部随州地区。春秋战国时期，周边地域为随国或曾国领土，处于楚文化圈内。叶家山墓地的发掘为这一古代区域世界提供了新证据。

english: Meisenheim lies in the valley of the Glan on the northern edge of the North Palatine Uplands. Its compact riverside setting places the town among the villages of the Rhineland’s upland country.
simp_chinese: 迈森海姆位于北普法尔茨山地北缘的格兰河谷。紧凑的滨河城镇坐落在莱茵兰丘陵乡村之间。

english:
Meissen rises above the Elbe in the land of the Polabian Slavs. Henry the Fowler founded the fortress of Misnia in 929, and the settlement became a bishop's seat in 968. As the centre of a frontier march, it served both the expansion of imperial power and the growth of a market town. The Wettin dynasty acquired the margraviate in 1089 and made it a lasting foundation of its authority in Saxony.

Castle and cathedral shared the prominent hill above the town. Work on the Gothic cathedral began in 1260, while the later Albrechtsburg took shape from 1472 onward. That princely residence acquired an unexpected second life when Augustus the Strong established his porcelain manufactory there in 1710. Local clay, court patronage and skilled production transformed the name of an old frontier stronghold into one associated with fine porcelain across Europe.
simp_chinese:
迈森俯临易北河，地处波拉布斯拉夫人原先居住的土地。捕鸟者亨利于929年建立米斯尼亚要塞，聚落又于968年成为主教驻地。作为边疆藩侯领地的中心，它既服务于帝国权力的扩展，也逐渐成长为市场城镇。韦廷王朝于1089年取得藩侯领地，将迈森变为其在萨克森长期统治的重要根基。

城堡与大教堂共同占据城镇上方的显著山丘。哥特式大教堂于1260年开始兴建，后来的阿尔布雷希特堡则从1472年起逐步建成。这座诸侯居所后来有了出人意料的新用途：强力王奥古斯特于1710年在此设立瓷器工场。当地黏土、宫廷赞助与精湛生产技艺，使古老边疆要塞的名字在欧洲各地成为精美瓷器的象征。

english: Meixian belongs to the western Shaanxi country around Fengxiang. The wider historical centre at Yong served as a capital of ancient Qin, while Fengxiang later became a Tang western capital and the capital of the tenth-century Qi kingdom.
simp_chinese: 郿县属于陕西西部凤翔周围地区。广义历史中心雍曾是古秦国都城，凤翔后来又成为唐代西京及十世纪岐国都城。

english: Meizhou, now called Meishan, lies in the southwestern Sichuan Basin. The wider region has ancient administrative roots, including the former county of Wuyang in the Pengshan area.
simp_chinese: 眉州今称眉山，位于四川盆地西南部。更广阔地区的行政历史悠久，包括彭山一带的古武阳县。

english: Mèjňypilgyn occupies a spit on the Bering Sea beside the Vaamochka and Pekulney lakes. Its Chukchi name means 'the mouth', referring to the channel connecting lagoon and sea. The modern village was founded in 1957, continuing habitation in this coastal lake landscape.
simp_chinese: 梅日尼皮尔金坐落于白令海岸瓦莫奇卡湖与佩库利内伊湖旁的沙嘴。其楚科奇语名称意为“口”，指连接潟湖与大海的水道。现代村庄建于1957年，延续着这片海岸湖区的人居。

english: Mekapisk belongs to Newfoundland’s Long Range country. The wider island forms the maritime half of Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada’s easternmost province.
simp_chinese: 梅卡皮斯克属于纽芬兰的长岭地区。更广阔的纽芬兰岛构成加拿大最东部省份纽芬兰与拉布拉多的岛屿部分。

english:
Mekele stands on the limestone highlands of Enderta, near the northern Ethiopian Rift. It is believed to have grown from the thirteenth-century hamlet of Enda Meseqel, later called Enda Medhane Alem. By the early nineteenth century it was becoming a town: Ras Wolde Selassie governed from Antalo but used the country around Mekele, forty kilometres to the north, as a place of recreation.

Its greatest expansion came later in the nineteenth century, when Yohannes IV made it his political capital. Rich farming country in Raya Azebo, access to Afar salt and the routes toward Shewa and the Red Sea helped give the site strategic value. His palace, built in 1882–84, and the Monday market drew nobles, servants, traders and craftspeople to the growing centre. Salt caravans linked this highland settlement to the arid country below, sustaining a commercial importance that survived the later rise of Addis Ababa.
simp_chinese:
默克莱位于恩德尔塔的石灰岩高地，靠近埃塞俄比亚裂谷北段。人们认为它由十三世纪名为恩达梅瑟克尔、后来改称恩达梅德哈内阿莱姆的小村发展而来。十九世纪初，它逐渐成为城镇：拉斯·沃尔德·塞拉西以安塔洛为统治中心，却将北面四十公里外的默克莱一带用作游憩之地。

更大规模的发展出现在十九世纪后期，约翰尼斯四世将这里设为政治首都。拉亚阿泽博肥沃的农地、通往阿法尔盐产区的路线，以及前往绍阿和红海的道路，都赋予此地战略价值。1882至1884年营建的宫殿与周一市场，吸引贵族、侍从、商人和手艺人聚集。盐商队把这处高地聚落与下方的干旱地区联结起来，使它在后来亚的斯亚贝巴崛起后仍保持商业上的重要性。

english: These forests belong to the Mekeo language region of Papua New Guinea. Mekeo is an Oceanic language with several regional varieties, spoken by communities including those of Ongofoina and Inauaisa.
simp_chinese: 这片森林属于巴布亚新几内亚的梅凯奥语地区。梅凯奥语是一种具有多个地方变体的大洋洲语言，翁戈福伊纳与伊瑙艾萨等社群使用这一语言。

english: Mekimdya belongs to the rural country around Olyokminsk in the Sakha Republic. It lies about eighty kilometres from the district centre and thirty-six kilometres from Khorintsy. By the 2002 census it had no recorded inhabitants, a modern reminder of the fragile settlement pattern of this vast region.
simp_chinese: 梅金贾属于萨哈共和国奥廖克明斯克周边的乡村地区，距行政中心约八十公里、距霍林齐三十六公里。2002年人口普查已无居民登记，体现了这片广阔地区聚落分布在现代的脆弱性。

english: Mékinac belongs to the country later organized as Lower Canada. The wider colony occupied the lower Saint Lawrence region from 1791 to 1841, following the division of the British Province of Quebec.
simp_chinese: 梅基纳克属于后来划为下加拿大的地区。更广阔的殖民地在英国魁北克省分割后，于1791至1841年间包括圣劳伦斯河下游地区。

english: Mekinock is a settlement northwest of Grand Forks in North Dakota. A post office opened here in 1879, marking a stage in its later nineteenth-century development. The modern community forms part of the inhabited eastern Grand Forks County countryside.
simp_chinese: 梅基诺克位于北达科他州大福克斯西北方。1879年当地开设邮局，标志着十九世纪后期发展的一环。现代社群属于大福克斯县东部有人定居的乡间地区。

english: The Kuril waters formed part of the northern island world that medieval Japanese writers came to call Ezo. By the late fifteenth century, this term encompassed Hokkaido, Sakhalin and the Kuril Islands, lands associated with the Ainu.
simp_chinese: 千岛群岛水域属于中世纪日本文献逐渐称为“虾夷”的北方岛屿世界。到十五世纪后期，这个名称已涵盖北海道、库页岛和千岛群岛这些与阿伊努人有关的土地。

english: The seas around Butung lie within eastern Indonesia. The archipelago stretches toward New Guinea and the Pacific, with rich marine habitats surrounding its many islands.
simp_chinese: 布通周围海域位于印度尼西亚东部。群岛向新几内亚与太平洋延伸，众多岛屿外分布丰富海洋栖息地。

english: Mekletin belongs to the wider Astrakhan steppe country. At the regional scale, the lower Volga and Caspian Depression connected caravan and water routes. Astrakhan grew as a trading centre and later became the capital of a khanate descended from the Golden Horde.
simp_chinese: 梅克列京属于广义的阿斯特拉罕草原地区。从区域尺度看，伏尔加河下游与里海低地连接着商队和水路。阿斯特拉罕作为贸易中心发展，后来成为源于金帐汗国的一个汗国的都城。

english: Meknes takes its name from the Miknasa, whose villages preceded the Almoravid fortress that formed the core of the later city. The Marinids added a kasbah in 1276 and endowed the town with mosques and schools, including the richly decorated Bou Inania madrasa of 1335–1336. Its greatest transformation came after Moulay Ismail chose it as his capital in 1672. Over a reign of fifty-five years he built a vast palace city, with monumental walls, gates, gardens and storehouses. The name of el-Hedim Square, meaning rubble, recalls the demolitions that cleared space for this work. Water wheels, wells and channels supplied the royal enclosure, while enormous granaries provided reserves. Some vaulted chambers later popularly described as slave prisons were in fact storage spaces, a reminder that the city’s surviving monuments acquired legends as well as history.
simp_chinese: 梅克内斯得名于米克纳萨人；他们的村落早于穆拉比特王朝的堡垒，而那座堡垒后来形成了城市的核心。马林王朝于1276年增建城堡区，并为城镇修筑清真寺和学校，其中包括1335至1336年建成、装饰华美的布伊纳尼亚经学院。最深刻的变化发生在1672年穆莱·伊斯梅尔选定这里为首都之后。他在长达55年的统治中兴建了一座庞大的宫城，配有宏伟城墙、城门、花园和仓库。哈迪姆广场之名意为“瓦砾”，使人记起为这项工程腾地而进行的拆除。水车、水井和渠道向王城供水，巨型粮仓则储存物资。一些后来被民间说成奴隶监狱的拱顶房间，实际用途是储藏，提醒人们留存的古迹既承载历史，也积累传说。

english: The Mekong descends from the Tibetan Plateau through mainland Southeast Asia. Strong seasonal changes in flow, together with rapids and waterfalls, complicate navigation along this great river.
simp_chinese: 湄公河从青藏高原流向东南亚大陆。显著的季节流量变化，加上急流与瀑布，使这条大河的航行条件复杂。

english: Mekoryuq lies on Nunivak Island, homeland of the Nunivak Cup’ig people for roughly two millennia. Russian-American Company explorers arrived in 1821 and recorded numerous island villages, bringing this established maritime society into direct contact with Russian expansion.
simp_chinese: 梅科里尤克位于努尼瓦克岛，努尼瓦克库皮格人已在岛上生活约两千年。俄美公司探险者于1821年来访，记录了岛上众多村落，使这个既有海洋社会与俄国扩张直接接触。

english: Mekwiskajk belongs to Newfoundland's Avalon Peninsula. The wider peninsula projects toward the rich fishing grounds of the Grand Banks, with its major bays long supporting Newfoundland's fishing economy.
simp_chinese: 梅克维斯凯克属于纽芬兰的阿瓦隆半岛。更广阔的半岛伸向大浅滩丰饶渔场，其主要海湾长期支撑着纽芬兰渔业经济。

english: Mel Point belongs to the northeastern Brazilian coastal world around Cape São Roque. The wider cape marks the bend of the mainland closest to Africa. A Portuguese mapping expedition visited it in 1501 and named it for Saint Roch.
simp_chinese: 梅尔角属于圣罗克角周边巴西东北部海岸世界。广大地区的圣罗克角标示巴西大陆海岸最接近非洲的转折处。葡萄牙测绘远征于1501年到访，以圣罗克为其命名。

english: Melahuacan lies in the broader Tomatlán country of coastal Jalisco, south of Cabo Corrientes. Sixteenth-century accounts describe a coast of several languages and name a local speech as Tomatec. Before Spanish arrival, this region belonged to a varied Indigenous political and cultural landscape.
simp_chinese: 梅拉瓦坎位于科连特斯角以南、哈利斯科沿海较广的托马特兰地域。十六世纪记述描述了多种语言并存的海岸，并提到一种名为托马特克的地方语言。西班牙人到来以前，这里已有多样的原住民政治与文化景观。

english: Melamela belongs to the wider Melanesian island world. This southwestern Pacific region extends from New Guinea towards Fiji, including the Solomon Islands, Vanuatu and New Caledonia.
simp_chinese: 梅拉梅拉属于更广阔的美拉尼西亚群岛世界。这片西南太平洋地区从新几内亚延伸至斐济，包括所罗门群岛、瓦努阿图与新喀里多尼亚。

english: Melara belongs to Bali, the island between Java and Lombok. The wider island is known for its Balinese Hindu traditions and elaborate arts of dance, sculpture, painting and music.
simp_chinese: 美拉拉属于爪哇与龙目岛之间的巴厘岛。整座岛屿以巴厘印度教传统，以及舞蹈、雕塑、绘画与音乐等丰富艺术而闻名。

english: Mele Bay opens on Efate’s southwestern coast in Vanuatu. Ships approaching Port Vila pass through it towards smaller Vila Bay and Ifira Island, while Pango Point marks its southern tapering shore.
simp_chinese: 梅莱湾位于瓦努阿图埃法特岛西南岸。前往维拉港的船只经过这里，驶向更小的维拉湾与伊菲拉岛，潘戈角则标示着海湾南部收窄的岸线。

english: Melekess stands where the Melekesska meets the Bolshoy Cheremshan, a tributary of the Volga. The settlement was founded in 1714 as a village for workers at a local distillery, giving its early development a direct connection to rural production and river geography. Its historical name came from the Melekesska River. The larger urban centre developed much later: it received town status in 1919 and was renamed Dimitrovgrad in 1972. These later changes followed the modest workers' settlement from which the town had grown.
simp_chinese: 梅列克斯位于梅列克斯卡河与大切列姆尚河的汇流处，后者是伏尔加河的支流。聚落于1714年建立，最初是当地酿酒作坊工人的村庄，其早期发展直接联系着乡村生产与河流地理。历史名称取自流经这里的梅列克斯卡河。规模更大的城市中心出现得较晚：1919年取得城市地位，1972年又更名为季米特洛夫格勒。这些后来的变化，都承接着早年工人村落的发展。

english: The Melendiz Mountains belong to the Cappadocian country around Niğde. In the wider region, ancient routes connected Kayseri with the Cilician Gates and the Mediterranean, bringing successive peoples and empires through central Anatolia.
simp_chinese: 梅伦迪兹山脉属于尼代周边的卡帕多西亚地区。在更广阔的地区，古道将开塞利与奇里乞亚山口、地中海连接起来，使历代民族与帝国穿越安纳托利亚中部。

english: Melenki is a town in the Vladimir region of Russia. In modern administration it belongs to the district of Melenkovsky, distinguishing this urban settlement from the many villages with the same name.
simp_chinese: 梅连基是俄罗斯弗拉基米尔地区的一座城镇。现代行政上，它属于梅连基区，与许多同名村落有所区别。

english: Melenudo belongs to the wider Waco country along the Brazos River. The river corridor had been inhabited for thousands of years before the modern city arose. In the historical period, the Waco or Hueco, a Wichita people, occupied the locality that later gave the city its name.
simp_chinese: 梅莱努多属于布拉索斯河沿线的韦科地区。在现代城市出现前，这条河谷已有人类居住数千年。历史时期，威奇托人的一支韦科人，又写作Hueco，居住在后来以他们命名的城市所在地。

english: Meletovo belongs to the wider Pskov country of northwestern Rus'. The regional republic achieved formal independence from Novgorod in 1348 and developed its own legal traditions; recognition of Moscow’s suzerainty from 1399 preceded incorporation into the Russian state in 1510.
simp_chinese: 梅列托沃属于罗斯西北部广义的普斯科夫地区。地区共和国于1348年正式脱离诺夫哥罗德，并发展出自身的法律传统；1399年起承认莫斯科宗主权，最终于1510年并入俄罗斯国家。

english: Meleuz stands on the Belaya River in Bashkiria, south of Ufa. Recorded as a peasant village from 1786, it expanded much later with twentieth-century oil development and fertilizer production, receiving town status in 1958.
simp_chinese: 梅列乌兹坐落在乌法以南的巴什基里亚别拉亚河畔，1786年起已有农民村落的记录。这里直到二十世纪石油开发和化肥生产兴起后才大幅扩张，并于1958年获得城市地位。

english: Melfi rises on a hill beneath Mount Vulture, between the approaches to Naples and Bari. Its position between Byzantine and Lombard territories gave it strategic value before the Hauteville Normans made it a base for their conquest of southern Italy. In 1059 it became capital of the Duchy of Apulia and hosted a papal council. Frederick II gave the town another place in political history when he proclaimed the Constitutions of Melfi in 1231, strengthening royal government through salaried officials and taxation. Its castle was enlarged by the Angevins and later passed to the Doria family, reflecting successive rulers' interest in this commanding site.
simp_chinese: 梅尔菲坐落于武尔图雷山麓的丘陵，位于通向那不勒斯与巴里的道路之间。在诺曼人到来以前，它处于拜占庭与伦巴第势力之间的位置便具有战略价值；欧特维尔家族随后以此为征服意大利南部的基地。1059年，这里成为普利亚公国的首都，并举行教会会议。1231年，腓特烈二世在此颁布《梅尔菲宪章》，通过领取薪俸的官员和税制加强王权，再次使城镇进入政治史。城堡经安茹王朝扩建，后来又归多里亚家族所有，体现了历代统治者对这处制高据点的重视。

english: Melgueil, later called Mauguio, lies in the low country east of Montpellier. Above terrain only a few metres above the sea rises a striking artificial mound, raised by the lords of Melgueil as the site of their castle. This man-made height preserves the imprint of a medieval centre of Lower Languedoc. The nearby Etang de l'Or lagoon occupies a great part of the surrounding territory, beside fertile ground used for orchards, vineyards and market gardens. Castle mound, cultivated plain and coastal wetland give Melgueil its distinctive setting.
simp_chinese: 梅尔格伊后来称为莫吉奥，位于蒙彼利埃以东的低地。周围地面仅高出海面数米，一座醒目的人工土丘却拔地而起；梅尔格伊领主修筑此丘，用来安置自己的城堡。这处人造高地，保存了下朗格多克一座中世纪中心的历史印记。附近的金池潟湖占据周边大片土地，旁边的肥沃田地则用于果园、葡萄园与菜圃。城堡土丘、耕作平原与滨海湿地，共同构成了梅尔格伊独特的地理环境。

english: Meli lema belongs to the Molala country of the western Cascades. The Molala were an Indigenous people of this mountainous region; their descendants now form part of communities including Grand Ronde, Siletz and the Klamath Tribes.
simp_chinese: 梅利勒马属于西喀斯喀特的莫拉拉人地域。莫拉拉人世居这片山地，其后裔如今分布于大龙德、锡莱茨及克拉马斯诸部等社群。

english: Meli Pillan lies in the Pikunmapu country of the Andean world. Beyond the local landscape, the Andes stretch through seven countries along South America’s western side. Deep intermontane valleys and high plateaus break the mountain chains into a varied succession of environments.
simp_chinese: 梅利皮扬位于安第斯世界的皮昆马普地区。当地景观之外，安第斯沿南美洲西侧延伸，跨越七国。深切的山间谷地与高原将山链分隔，形成一系列多样环境。

english: The seas of eastern Indonesia surround a diverse archipelago. Sulawesi and parts of New Guinea belong to this broad meeting of Asian and Oceanian island worlds.
simp_chinese: 印度尼西亚东部海域环绕着多样的群岛。苏拉威西与部分新几内亚，属于亚洲和大洋洲岛屿世界的广阔交汇地区。

english:
On the eastern side of Cape Three Forks, Melilla occupies a coastal position long attractive to Mediterranean shipping. Phoenician seafarers established the trading outpost of Rusadir here; under Roman rule it belonged to Mauretania Tingitana. A bee on its ancient bronze coinage recalls the locality's association with beekeeping.

The medieval port passed through successive North African dynasties and declined amid struggles between Fez and Tlemcen. In September 1497 an expedition led by Pedro de Estopiñán occupied the largely abandoned site for the Duke of Medina Sidonia with royal support. Joint ducal and royal responsibility lasted until 1556. Thereafter the fortified core of Melilla la Vieja remained primarily a military garrison, with few civilians. Its walls embodied a foothold on the Rif coast whose defence repeatedly drew in the neighbouring Moroccan powers.
simp_chinese:
梅利利亚位于三岔角半岛东侧，地处长久吸引地中海航船的海岸位置。腓尼基航海者在此建立名为鲁萨迪尔的贸易据点；罗马统治时期，它归属廷吉塔纳毛里塔尼亚。古代铜币上的蜜蜂图案，留下了当地与养蜂活动相联系的痕迹。

中世纪港口先后经历多个北非王朝统治，并在非斯与特莱姆森的争夺中衰落。1497年9月，佩德罗·德·埃斯托皮尼安率领的远征队，在王室支持下为梅迪纳—西多尼亚公爵占领了大体荒废的据点。公爵与王室共同负责此地的安排延续至1556年。此后，梅利利亚老城的防御核心长期主要作为驻军要塞，平民很少。城墙围起了里夫海岸上的一处立足点，其防卫也屡次牵动周边的摩洛哥势力。

english: Melimoyu is an ice-capped volcanic massif in Chilean Patagonia. Its elongated complex contains nested calderas and several summits rising prominently above the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 梅利莫尤是智利巴塔哥尼亚一座覆盖冰帽的火山山体。其狭长火山复合体包含嵌套破火山口，多座山峰显著高出周围地形。

english: Melincué occupies a closed basin in the plains of Santa Fe, with no river carrying its waters onward to the sea. Its fluctuating shallows form a wetland habitat rich in waterfowl, while drought can leave the lake increasingly saline. The shore is therefore a changing boundary. In the later recorded history of neighbouring settlements, rising water repeatedly flooded parts of the basin and disrupted roads, showing how easily dry ground could return to open water. The lake and its surrounding marshes belong to the same variable landscape, sustaining birds while imposing limits upon permanent settlement.
simp_chinese: 梅林奎湖位于圣菲平原的一片封闭湖盆中，没有河流将湖水继续带向海洋。涨落不定的浅水构成水鸟繁多的湿地，干旱则会使湖水的盐分逐渐升高。因此，湖岸始终是一条变化中的边界。周围聚落较晚近的记录显示，水位上涨反复淹没湖盆部分地带并阻断道路，说明看似干燥的地面也可能重新成为水域。湖泊与周边沼泽同属这片多变的景观，在养育鸟类的同时，也限制着永久定居的范围。

english: Melitopol stands on the Molochna River, whose waters reach the Molochnyi estuary on the northern approaches to the Sea of Azov. The settlement took shape during the Russian Empire's expansion into the steppe: a redoubt was built here in 1769, and Cossack families and retired soldiers settled on the river's right bank after the creation of Taurida Oblast in 1784. Known as Novoalexandrovka in 1816, it received town status and the name Melitopol in 1842. Its Greek-derived name means 'honey city', recalling a port named Melita at the river's mouth.
simp_chinese: 梅利托波尔坐落在莫洛奇纳河畔，河水注入亚速海北侧的莫洛奇内潟湖。聚落的形成与俄罗斯帝国向草原扩张相连：1769年这里修筑了堡垒，1784年塔夫里达州建立后，哥萨克家庭和退役士兵迁居河流右岸。此地于1816年称新亚历山德罗夫卡，1842年取得城市地位，并改名梅利托波尔。这个源于希腊语的名字意为“蜂蜜之城”，呼应了河口一座名为梅利塔的港口。

english: Melk stands beside the Danube at the edge of the Wachau valley, beneath a bluff long associated with Austrian power and monastic life. It appears as Medilica in a donation by Louis the German in 831. The surrounding district was granted to Margrave Leopold I in 976 as a frontier buffer between Bavaria and the Magyars. A Babenberg castle occupied the height until Leopold II gave the site to Benedictine monks from Lambach in 1089. The town received market rights in 1227, developing below the monastery. Its later streets preserve further layers of civic life, including the town hall built in 1575 and houses carrying reminders of the Danube's destructive floods.
simp_chinese: 梅尔克坐落在多瑙河畔、瓦豪河谷边缘，城上的高崖长久以来与奥地利的统治权及修道生活相连。831年，日耳曼人路易的捐赠文书以梅迪利卡之名提及此地。976年，周围地区授予边疆伯爵利奥波德一世，作为巴伐利亚与马扎尔人之间的边境缓冲。巴本堡家族的城堡曾占据高处，直到1089年，利奥波德二世将其交给来自兰巴赫的本笃会修士。城镇于1227年获得集市权，在修道院下方发展。后来的街巷保存着更多市民生活的层次，包括1575年修建的市政厅，以及留有多瑙河洪灾印记的房屋。

english: Mellahet el Brega belongs to the broader Maghrebi country of North Africa. This regional world encompasses Mediterranean coastal lands as well as extensive Saharan territory, with Egypt generally placed outside it.
simp_chinese: 布雷加盐地属于北非广阔的马格里布地区。这一地域既涵盖地中海沿岸，也包括广大撒哈拉土地，埃及通常被划在其范围之外。

english: Melide, also called Mellid, grew in inland Galicia where the French Way and the Camino Primitivo converge on the pilgrimage to Santiago de Compostela. Its history as a settlement dates to the tenth century, and its place on the pilgrim roads remained central to its identity. In 1320 Archbishop Berenguel de Landoira granted permission to build a castle, fortify the village and levy taxes. That fortified order was broken during the Irmandiño revolt of 1467, when opponents of archiepiscopal power destroyed the walls and castle. The Catholic Monarchs subsequently prohibited the construction of another fortress. The meeting of roads endured, while the stronghold through which lords had controlled it disappeared.
simp_chinese: 梅利德又写作 Mellid，兴起于加利西亚内陆，通向圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉的法国之路与原始之路在此交汇。聚落历史可以追溯到十世纪，朝圣道路上的位置始终构成其身份的核心。1320年，大主教贝伦格尔·德兰多伊拉准许当地建造城堡、修筑防御并征收税款。1467年，反对大主教权力的伊尔曼迪尼奥起义摧毁了城墙与城堡，打破了这种以堡垒维系的秩序。天主教双王随后禁止在村镇重新兴建要塞。道路的交汇点延续下来，领主曾用来控制它的据点却消失了。

english: Mellrichstadt's recorded history reaches back to 751, when it appeared in a Frankish nobleman's deed of gift. The settlement later received town rights around 1230 and developed as a trading centre in Franconia. Its long continuity places it among the older settlements of the region, while the grant of urban privileges marks its growth beyond a rural foundation. The town also belongs to the world of Franconian churchmen and humanists: Lorenz von Bibra, later prince-bishop of Würzburg, and the poet and composer Paulus Melissus are counted among its notable figures.
simp_chinese: 梅尔里希施塔特的文献历史可追溯至751年，当时它出现在一位法兰克贵族的赠与契约中。聚落后来于1230年前后获得城市权利，并发展为弗兰肯的一处贸易中心。漫长的延续使其跻身地区较古老的聚落之列，而城市特权的授予则标志着它逐渐超出乡村聚落的规模。城镇也与弗兰肯的教会和人文传统相连：后来担任维尔茨堡采邑主教的洛伦茨·冯·比布拉，以及诗人兼作曲家保卢斯·梅利苏斯，都是与这里有关的人物。

english: Melnik belongs to the Pirin country of the Balkans. The wider mountain range stands between the Struma and Mesta valleys and contains more than a hundred glacial lakes.
simp_chinese: 梅尔尼克属于巴尔干的皮林地区。更广阔的皮林山脉位于斯特鲁马河谷与梅斯塔河谷之间，分布着一百多个冰川湖。

english: Melnikovo is a rural settlement in western Siberia’s Tomsk country. It belongs to the Shegarsky district, distinguishing it from other Russian villages that share the same name.
simp_chinese: 梅利尼科沃是西西伯利亚托木斯克地区的一处乡村聚落。它属于舍加尔区，与俄罗斯其他同名村落相区别。

english: Melnya belongs to the wider Nizhyn country of northern Ukraine. Nizhyn, the regional centre on the Oster, was recorded in 1147 and later served as an administrative centre of the Cossack Hetmanate.
simp_chinese: 梅利尼亚处于乌克兰北部广义的尼任地区。奥斯捷尔河畔的区域中心尼任于1147年见于记载，后来成为哥萨克酋长国的行政中心。

english: Melnytsya belongs to the wider historical landscape of Volhynia around Volodymyr. Volodymyr served as a capital of a principality and later of Galicia–Volhynia, while the nearby Zymne monastery became a notable religious center.
simp_chinese: 梅利尼察属于沃洛迪米尔周边更广阔的沃里尼亚历史地域。沃洛迪米尔曾是公国及后来的加利西亚—沃里尼亚的都城，附近的济姆内修道院则是著名的宗教中心。

english: The Melpa-speaking country surrounds Mount Hagen in the New Guinea highlands. Kawelka and related communities share this Papuan language. A special pandanus register used during karuka harvests links speech with seasonal gathering, while a binary counting system gives Melpa another distinctive cultural feature.
simp_chinese: 梅尔帕语地区环绕新几内亚高地的哈根山，卡韦尔卡及相关社群共同使用这种巴布亚语言。采收卡鲁卡露兜果时使用的特殊语体，将语言与季节性采集相连；二进制计数方式也是其鲜明文化特征。

english: Melsungen stands on the Fulda in the North Hesse Highlands, where the Pfieffe and Kehrenbach join the river. Recorded in 802, it had developed into a small town by 1189 and gained importance at the crossing of three medieval roads: the Sälzerweg, the Nuremberg road and the route through the 'Long Hessians.' The same position exposed it to competition between the archbishops of Mainz and the landgraves of Hesse and Thuringia. Fire damaged the center in 1554, but sixteenth-century building left enduring landmarks, including a town hall of 1556 and the Axe Whetters' Bridge of 1595–1596. The town's nickname, Bartenwetzer, remembers these 'axe whetters,' linking civic identity to a craft image preserved beside the river.
simp_chinese: 梅尔松根位于北黑森高地的富尔达河畔，普菲费溪与凯伦巴赫溪在城中汇入大河。聚落于802年已有记载，至1189年发展为小城，并因三条中世纪道路交汇而日益重要：萨尔策韦格、纽伦堡大道以及穿越“长黑森”的路线。同样的地理位置，也使它成为美因茨大主教与黑森、图林根伯爵争夺的对象。1554年火灾破坏了市中心，但十六世纪的建设留下持久地标，包括1556年的市政厅以及1595至1596年建成的磨斧人桥。居民以“磨斧人”自称，使这一手艺形象成为河畔城镇身份的一部分。

english: Melun occupies an old crossing of the Seine southeast of Paris. Caesar knew Meledunum as a town of the Senones on an island, linked by a wooden bridge that his soldiers repaired. Under Roman rule it served as a changing station where official couriers obtained fresh horses on the road from Paris. The Normans sacked the town in 845, but its castle later became a residence of the Capetian kings. Royal favour and the ambitions of neighbouring counts repeatedly drew Melun into dynastic disputes: Robert II recovered it for Bouchard in 999 and died here in 1031. Island, bridge, and royal castle gave this river town a significance greater than its size.
simp_chinese: 默伦位于巴黎东南方塞纳河的一处古老渡口。凯撒记述的梅莱杜努姆，是塞农人建于河岛上的城镇，由一座木桥连接，他的士兵曾修复这座桥。罗马统治时期，这里是巴黎外出道路上的换马站，为官方信使提供新马。诺曼人于845年洗劫城镇，但此后的城堡成为卡佩王朝国王的居所。王室宠信与邻近伯爵的野心，使默伦屡次卷入王朝纷争：罗贝尔二世于999年为布沙尔夺回此地，并在1031年于此去世。河岛、桥梁与王家城堡，赋予这座河畔城镇超出其规模的重要性。

english: Memba lies within the wider Swahili coast of eastern Africa, a region connected to the Indian Ocean. Along this coast, monsoon winds and sheltered river mouths supported maritime trade, while farming, herding and fishing sustained local communities.
simp_chinese: 门巴位于东非广阔的斯瓦希里海岸，面向印度洋。在这片海岸，季风和有遮蔽的河口支持海上贸易，农业、畜牧与捕鱼则维持着当地社会。
